functions.name: Update email to users
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public."Update email to users"()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$begin

UPDATE form_entries f
SET email = sub.extracted_email
FROM (
  SELECT 
    f.id AS form_entries_id,
    (REGEXP_MATCHES(m.message, '([a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,})'))[1] AS extracted_email
  FROM form_entries f
  JOIN users_personal_group_view u ON f.id = u.form_entries_id
  JOIN msg_lw_log m ON u.channel_id = m.channel_id
  WHERE f.email IS NULL
    AND m.message ~* '[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}'
) sub
WHERE f.id = sub.form_entries_id
  AND sub.extracted_email IS NOT NULL;

  end$function$

functions.name: add_meeting_shifts_eom
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_meeting_shifts_eom(p_kaipoke_cs_id text DEFAULT '9999999980'::text, p_minutes integer DEFAULT 15)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_inserted integer := 0;
    v_meeting_date date;
    v_base_time time without time zone := time '18:00';
BEGIN
    -- 当月の月末日を計算
    v_meeting_date := (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::date;

    WITH month_span AS (
        SELECT date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date AS dfrom,
               (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS dto
    ),
    raw_users AS (
        -- 当月に一度でもシフト登録されているユーザー（staff_01/02/03）の user_id を取得
        SELECT staff_01_user_id AS user_id FROM public.shift s
          JOIN month_span m ON s.shift_start_date >= m.dfrom AND s.shift_start_date < m.dto
        UNION ALL
        SELECT staff_02_user_id FROM public.shift s
          JOIN month_span m ON s.shift_start_date >= m.dfrom AND s.shift_start_date < m.dto
        UNION ALL
        SELECT staff_03_user_id FROM public.shift s
          JOIN month_span m ON s.shift_start_date >= m.dfrom AND s.shift_start_date < m.dto
    ),
    eligible_distinct AS (
        -- user_entry_united_view_single.level_sort > 3500000 かつ NULL/空文字でないもの
        SELECT DISTINCT ru.user_id
        FROM raw_users ru
        JOIN public.user_entry_united_view_single u ON u.user_id = ru.user_id
        WHERE ru.user_id IS NOT NULL
          AND ru.user_id <> ''
          AND u.level_sort > 3500000
    ),
    numbered AS (
        -- ずらし用の連番
        SELECT user_id,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) - 1 AS rn
        FROM eligible_distinct
    ),
    ins AS (
        INSERT INTO public.shift (
            kaipoke_cs_id,
            shift_start_date,
            shift_start_time,
            shift_end_date,
            shift_end_time,
            service_code,
            staff_01_user_id,
            required_staff_count,
            two_person_work_flg,
            staff_01_role_code
        )
        SELECT
            p_kaipoke_cs_id,
            v_meeting_date,
            (v_base_time + (rn * (p_minutes || ' minutes')::interval))::time,
            v_meeting_date,
            (v_base_time + ((rn + 1) * (p_minutes || ' minutes')::interval))::time,
            'MEETING',
            user_id,
            1,
            FALSE,
            '-999'
        FROM numbered
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.shift sh
            WHERE sh.kaipoke_cs_id   = p_kaipoke_cs_id
              AND sh.shift_start_date = v_meeting_date
              AND sh.shift_start_time = (v_base_time + (rn * (p_minutes || ' minutes')::interval))::time
        )
        RETURNING 1
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_inserted FROM ins;

    RETURN v_inserted;
END;
$function$

functions.name: add_meeting_shifts_for_month_eom_same_time
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_meeting_shifts_for_month_eom_same_time(p_target_ym text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_kaipoke_cs_id text DEFAULT '9999999980'::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_inserted      integer := 0;
    v_month_start   date;
    v_month_next    date;
    v_meeting_date  date;
BEGIN
    -- 対象月の1日
    IF p_target_ym IS NULL OR btrim(p_target_ym) = '' THEN
        v_month_start := date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date;
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            v_month_start := to_date(p_target_ym || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
        EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_target_ym must be in YYYY-MM format. Given: %', p_target_ym;
        END;
    END IF;

    v_month_next   := (v_month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')::date;
    v_meeting_date := (v_month_next - INTERVAL '1 day')::date; -- 月末日

    WITH month_span AS (
        SELECT v_month_start AS dfrom, v_month_next AS dto
    ),
    raw_users AS (
        -- 対象月に一度でもシフト登録された user_id（staff_01/02/03）
        SELECT staff_01_user_id AS user_id
          FROM public.shift s
          JOIN month_span m ON s.shift_start_date >= m.dfrom AND s.shift_start_date < m.dto
        UNION ALL
        SELECT staff_02_user_id FROM public.shift s
          JOIN month_span m ON s.shift_start_date >= m.dfrom AND s.shift_start_date < m.dto
        UNION ALL
        SELECT staff_03_user_id FROM public.shift s
          JOIN month_span m ON s.shift_start_date >= m.dfrom AND s.shift_start_date < m.dto
    ),
    eligible AS (
        -- NULL/空文字除外 & level_sort > 3500000
        SELECT DISTINCT ru.user_id
        FROM raw_users ru
        JOIN public.user_entry_united_view_single u ON u.user_id = ru.user_id
        WHERE ru.user_id IS NOT NULL
          AND ru.user_id <> ''
          AND u.level_sort > 3500000
    ),
    numbered AS (
        -- 連番（0始まり）。この連番を required_staff_count に 1,2,3,... として使う
        SELECT
            e.user_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.user_id) AS req_num -- 1,2,3,...
        FROM eligible e
    ),
    ins AS (
        INSERT INTO public.shift (
            kaipoke_cs_id,
            shift_start_date,
            shift_start_time,
            shift_end_date,
            shift_end_time,
            service_code,
            staff_01_user_id,
            required_staff_count,
            two_person_work_flg,
            staff_01_role_code
        )
        SELECT
            p_kaipoke_cs_id,
            v_meeting_date,
            time '18:00',
            v_meeting_date,
            time '18:15',
            'MEETING',
            n.user_id,
            n.req_num,           -- ★ ユニークキーに入る列を連番にして衝突回避
            FALSE,
            '-999'
        FROM numbered n
        ON CONFLICT (kaipoke_cs_id, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, required_staff_count)
        DO NOTHING
        RETURNING 1
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_inserted FROM ins;

    RETURN v_inserted;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_office_to_fax(p_fax_received_id bigint, p_office_id bigint, p_assigned_by character varying, p_is_primary boolean DEFAULT false, p_register_fax_proxy boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_fax_number VARCHAR(20);
BEGIN
  -- 入力チェック
  IF p_fax_received_id IS NULL OR p_office_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', FALSE, 'error', 'fax_received_id and office_id are required');
  END IF;
  
  -- FAX番号を取得
  SELECT fax_number INTO v_fax_number
  FROM cm_fax_received
  WHERE id = p_fax_received_id;
  
  IF v_fax_number IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', FALSE, 'error', 'FAX received record not found');
  END IF;
  
  -- fax_proxy登録が指定されている場合
  IF p_register_fax_proxy AND v_fax_number IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE cm_kaipoke_other_office
    SET fax_proxy = v_fax_number
    WHERE id = p_office_id
      AND (fax_proxy IS NULL OR fax_proxy != v_fax_number);
  END IF;
  
  -- is_primary=trueの場合、既存のprimaryをfalseに
  IF p_is_primary THEN
    UPDATE cm_fax_received_offices
    SET is_primary = FALSE
    WHERE fax_received_id = p_fax_received_id
      AND is_primary = TRUE;
    
    -- cm_fax_received.office_id も更新（後方互換）
    UPDATE cm_fax_received
    SET 
      office_id = p_office_id,
      office_assigned_by = p_assigned_by,
      office_assigned_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = p_fax_received_id;
  END IF;
  
  -- 事業所を追加（または更新）
  INSERT INTO cm_fax_received_offices (
    fax_received_id,
    office_id,
    is_primary,
    assigned_by,
    assigned_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_fax_received_id,
    p_office_id,
    p_is_primary,
    p_assigned_by,
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (fax_received_id, office_id) DO UPDATE SET
    is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary,
    assigned_by = EXCLUDED.assigned_by,
    assigned_at = EXCLUDED.assigned_at;
  
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'fax_received_id', p_fax_received_id,
    'office_id', p_office_id,
    'is_primary', p_is_primary,
    'fax_proxy_registered', p_register_fax_proxy
  );
END;
$function$

 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_alert_id UUID;
BEGIN
  UPDATE cm_alerts
  SET
    status = 'resolved',
    resolved_at = NOW(),
    resolution_note = p_resolution_note,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE kaipoke_cs_id = p_kaipoke_cs_id
    AND category = p_category
    AND details->>'reference_id' = p_reference_id

  RETURNING id INTO v_alert_id;

  RETURN v_alert_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cm_resolve_alerts_by_termination(p_category text, p_resolution_note text DEFAULT '利用者が利用終了'::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  -- 利用終了した利用者のアラートを resolved に更新
  WITH terminated_clients AS (
    SELECT kaipoke_cs_id
    FROM cm_kaipoke_info  -- ★修正: cs_ → cm_
    WHERE client_status != '利用中'  -- ★修正: status → client_status
  ),
  updated AS (
    UPDATE cm_alerts a
    SET
      status = 'resolved',
      resolved_at = NOW(),
      resolution_note = p_resolution_note,
      updated_at = NOW()
    FROM terminated_clients tc
    WHERE a.kaipoke_cs_id = tc.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND a.category = p_category
      AND a.status != 'resolved'
    RETURNING a.id
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM updated;

  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cron_sync_cs_documents()
 RETURNS TABLE(updated_infos bigint, relabeled_documents bigint, fixed_doc_names bigint, matched_kaipoke_ids bigint, filled_doc_dates bigint, unresolved bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_updated_infos bigint := 0;
  v_relabeled_documents bigint := 0;
  v_fixed_doc_names bigint := 0;
  v_matched_kaipoke_ids bigint := 0;
  v_filled_doc_dates bigint := 0;
  v_unresolved bigint := 0;
begin
  -- ======================================================
  -- ① cs_docs.doc_name 補正
  -- ======================================================
  with candidates as (
    select
      d.id,
      d.doc_name as old_doc_name,
      public.classify_cs_doc_label(
        coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, ''),
        d.doc_name
      ) as new_doc_name
    from public.cs_docs d
    where coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.doc_name), ''), '分類不能') = '分類不能'
  )
  update public.cs_docs d
     set doc_name = c.new_doc_name,
         updated_at = now()
    from candidates c
   where d.id = c.id
     and coalesce(c.new_doc_name, '') <> ''
     and c.new_doc_name <> '分類不能'
     and coalesce(d.doc_name, '') is distinct from c.new_doc_name;

  get diagnostics v_fixed_doc_names = row_count;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ② kaipoke_cs_id 名寄せ
  -- ======================================================
  with src as (
    select
      d.id,
      d.kaipoke_cs_id,
      d.summary,
      d.ocr_text,
      coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '') as joined_text,
      public.extract_user_name_raw(coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '')) as extracted_name,
      public.extract_doc_date_raw(coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '')) as extracted_doc_date_raw
    from public.cs_docs d
    where d.kaipoke_cs_id is null
  ),
  matched as (
    select
      s.id,
      public.pick_best_kaipoke_cs_id(
        s.extracted_name,
        s.joined_text,
        s.extracted_doc_date_raw
      ) as new_kaipoke_cs_id
    from src s
  )
  update public.cs_docs d
     set kaipoke_cs_id = m.new_kaipoke_cs_id,
         updated_at = now()
    from matched m
   where d.id = m.id
     and m.new_kaipoke_cs_id is not null
     and d.kaipoke_cs_id is null;

  get diagnostics v_matched_kaipoke_ids = row_count;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ③ doc_date_raw 補完
  -- 注意: cs_docs.doc_date_raw は timestamptz
  -- extract_doc_date_raw() は text を返すので、
  -- ここでは parse 可能なものだけ timestamptz 化
  -- ======================================================
  with dates as (
    select
      d.id,
      public.extract_doc_date_raw(coalesce(d.summary, '') || E'\n' || coalesce(d.ocr_text, '')) as extracted_raw
    from public.cs_docs d
    where d.doc_date_raw is null
  ),
  parsed as (
    select
      id,
      case
        when extracted_raw ~ '^\d{4}[-/\.]\d{1,2}[-/\.]\d{1,2}$'
          then replace(replace(extracted_raw, '/', '-'), '.', '-')::date::timestamptz
        when extracted_raw ~ '^\d{4}[-/\.]\d{1,2}[-/\.]\d{1,2}日?$'
          then regexp_replace(replace(replace(extracted_raw, '/', '-'), '.', '-'), '日$', '')::date::timestamptz
        else null
      end as new_doc_date_raw
    from dates
  )
  update public.cs_docs d
     set doc_date_raw = p.new_doc_date_raw,
         updated_at = now()
    from parsed p
   where d.id = p.id
     and p.new_doc_date_raw is not null
     and d.doc_date_raw is null;

  get diagnostics v_filled_doc_dates = row_count;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ④ cs_docs -> cs_kaipoke_info.documents 同期
  -- ======================================================
  v_updated_infos := public.sync_cs_docs_to_kaipoke_documents();

  -- ======================================================
  -- ⑤ cs_kaipoke_info.documents 内 label 補正
  -- ======================================================
  with expanded as (
    select
      cki.id as cki_id,
      ordinality as ord,
      elem,
      elem->>'label' as old_label,
      public.classify_cs_doc_label(
        coalesce(elem->>'summary', '') || E'\n' || coalesce(elem->>'label', ''),
        elem->>'label'
      ) as new_label
    from public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cki.documents::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as t(elem, ordinality)
  ),
  rebuilt as (
    select
      cki_id,
      jsonb_agg(
        case
          when coalesce(old_label, '') in ('', '分類不能', '不明', '自由登録')
            or not exists (
              select 1
              from public.user_doc_master udm
              where udm.category = 'cs_doc'
                and udm.label = old_label
            )
          then jsonb_set(elem, '{label}', to_jsonb(new_label), true)
          else elem
        end
        order by ord
      ) as new_documents,
      count(*) filter (
        where (
          coalesce(old_label, '') in ('', '分類不能', '不明', '自由登録')
          or not exists (
            select 1
            from public.user_doc_master udm
            where udm.category = 'cs_doc'
              and udm.label = old_label
          )
        )
        and coalesce(new_label, '') <> coalesce(old_label, '')
      ) as changed_count
    from expanded
    group by cki_id
  )
  update public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
     set documents = rebuilt.new_documents
    from rebuilt
   where cki.id = rebuilt.cki_id
     and rebuilt.changed_count > 0;

  select coalesce(sum(changed_count), 0)
    into v_relabeled_documents
    from (
      with expanded as (
        select
          cki.id as cki_id,
          ordinality as ord,
          elem,
          elem->>'label' as old_label,
          public.classify_cs_doc_label(
            coalesce(elem->>'summary', '') || E'\n' || coalesce(elem->>'label', ''),
            elem->>'label'
          ) as new_label
        from public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
        cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cki.documents::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as t(elem, ordinality)
      )
      select
        cki_id,
        count(*) filter (
          where (
            coalesce(old_label, '') in ('', '分類不能', '不明', '自由登録')
            or not exists (
              select 1
              from public.user_doc_master udm
              where udm.category = 'cs_doc'
                and udm.label = old_label
            )
          )
          and coalesce(new_label, '') <> coalesce(old_label, '')
        ) as changed_count
      from expanded
      group by cki_id
    ) s;

  -- ======================================================
  -- ⑥ unresolved 件数
  -- ======================================================
  select count(*)
    into v_unresolved
    from public.cs_docs d
   where coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.doc_name), ''), '分類不能') = '分類不能'
      or d.kaipoke_cs_id is null
      or d.doc_date_raw is null;

  return query
  select
    v_updated_infos,
    v_relabeled_documents,
    v_fixed_doc_names,
    v_matched_kaipoke_ids,
    v_filled_doc_dates,
    v_unresolved;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows()
 RETURNS TABLE(year_month text, service_date date, service_category text, total_hours numeric, staff_user_id text, qualified boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with qualification_master as (
    select label
    from public.user_doc_master
    where category = 'certificate'
      and is_active = true
      and label in ('介護福祉士', '実務者研修修了')
  ),
  qualification_dates as (
    select
      fe.auth_uid,
      min(acquired.acquired_date) as qualified_from
    from public.form_entries fe
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(fe.attachments, '[]'::jsonb)) attachment(value)
    cross join lateral (
      select case
        when nullif(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at', '')
             ~ '^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])'
          then to_date(left(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at', 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      end as acquired_date
    ) acquired
    join qualification_master qm
      on qm.label = attachment.value ->> 'label'
    where fe.auth_uid is not null
      and attachment.value ->> 'type' in ('資格証明書', 'certificate', 'certification')
      and acquired.acquired_date is not null
      and to_char(acquired.acquired_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
          = left(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at', 10)
    group by fe.auth_uid
  ),
  participating_staff as (
    select
      s.shift_start_date::date as service_date,
      s.kaipoke_cs_id,
      s.service_code,
      participant.staff_user_id,
      case
        when (coalesce(s.shift_end_date, s.shift_start_date)::date + s.shift_end_time::time)
             <= (s.shift_start_date::date + s.shift_start_time::time)
          then extract(epoch from (
            (coalesce(s.shift_end_date, s.shift_start_date)::date + s.shift_end_time::time + interval '1 day')
            - (s.shift_start_date::date + s.shift_start_time::time)
          )) / 3600
        else extract(epoch from (
          (coalesce(s.shift_end_date, s.shift_start_date)::date + s.shift_end_time::time)
          - (s.shift_start_date::date + s.shift_start_time::time)
        )) / 3600
      end::numeric as hours
    from public.shift_shift_record_view s
    cross join lateral (
      values
        (s.staff_01_user_id, true),
        (s.staff_02_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false)),
        (s.staff_03_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false))
    ) as participant(staff_user_id, is_service_staff)
    where s.shift_start_date >= date '2025-11-01'
      and coalesce(s.kaipoke_cs_id, '') not like '99999999%'
      and coalesce(s.service_code, '') not like '%キャンセル%'
      and participant.is_service_staff
      and participant.staff_user_id is not null
      and s.shift_start_time is not null
      and s.shift_end_time is not null
  ),
  resolved_service as (
    select
      ps.*,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(ps.service_code), ''),
        fallback.service_code
      ) as effective_service_code
    from participating_staff ps
    left join lateral (
      select s2.service_code
      from public.shift_shift_record_view s2
      join public.shift_service_code sc2
        on sc2.service_code = s2.service_code
      where nullif(btrim(ps.service_code), '') is null
        and s2.kaipoke_cs_id = ps.kaipoke_cs_id
        and nullif(btrim(s2.service_code), '') is not null
        and s2.service_code not like '%キャンセル%'
        and (
          sc2.plan_service_category in (
            '居宅家事', '居宅身体', '通院等介助', '行動援護',
            '同行援護', '重度訪問', '移動支援'
          )
          or sc2.kaipoke_servicek in ('要介護', '要支援', '自費')
        )
      order by
        abs(s2.shift_start_date::date - ps.service_date),
        case when s2.shift_start_date::date <= ps.service_date then 0 else 1 end,
        s2.shift_start_date desc
      limit 1
    ) fallback on true
  ),
  classified_staff as (
    select
      ps.*,
      qd.qualified_from,
      case
        when sc.plan_service_category in ('居宅家事', '居宅身体', '通院等介助')
          then '障害福祉（家事・身体・通院等介助）'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '行動援護' then '行動援護'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '同行援護' then '同行援護'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '重度訪問' then '重度訪問'
        when sc.plan_service_category = '移動支援' then '移動支援'
        when sc.kaipoke_servicek = '要介護' then '訪問介護（要介護）'
        when sc.kaipoke_servicek = '要支援' then '訪問介護（要支援）'
        when sc.kaipoke_servicek = '自費' then '自費'
      end as service_category
    from resolved_service ps
    join public.user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = ps.staff_user_id
     and u.org_unit_id is not null
    join public.shift_service_code sc
      on sc.service_code = ps.effective_service_code
    left join qualification_dates qd
      on qd.auth_uid = u.auth_uid
  )
  select
    to_char(cs.service_date, 'YYYY-MM'),
    cs.service_date,
    cs.service_category,
    cs.hours,
    cs.staff_user_id,
    coalesce(cs.qualified_from <= cs.service_date, false)
  from classified_staff cs
  where cs.service_category is not null
    and cs.hours > 0;
$function$

functions.name: deploy_weekly_template
functions.identity_args: p_month text, p_cs_id text, p_policy text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deploy_weekly_template(p_month text, p_cs_id text, p_policy text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_start date := (p_month || '-01')::date;
  v_end   date := (v_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;
  v_ins   int := 0;
BEGIN
  -- 関数内だけタイムアウト延長（DB側）。REST側の8秒とは別枠
  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','30s', true);

  WITH tmpl AS (
    -- ★ 指定CSのテンプレだけ
    SELECT *
    FROM public.shift_weekly_template t
    WHERE t.active = true
      AND t.kaipoke_cs_id = p_cs_id
  ),
  days AS (
    SELECT g::date AS d
    FROM generate_series(v_start, v_end, interval '1 day') AS g
  ),
  cand_base AS (
    SELECT
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,
      d.d                                AS shift_start_date,
      t.start_time::time                 AS shift_start_time,
      t.end_time::time                   AS shift_end_time,
      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,
      t.staff_01_user_id, t.staff_02_user_id, t.staff_03_user_id,
      t.staff_02_attend_flg, t.staff_03_attend_flg,
      tsrange(
        (d.d::timestamp + t.start_time),
        (d.d::timestamp + t.end_time)
          + CASE WHEN t.end_time <= t.start_time THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '0' END,
        '[)'
      ) AS cand_range
    FROM tmpl t
    JOIN days d
      -- DOW: 日=0..土=6（テンプレweekdayも同じ前提）
      ON EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.d) = t.weekday
  ),
  -- 同一日付・開始時刻は1件にまとめる（多重テンプレ対策）
  cand_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (kaipoke_cs_id, shift_start_date, shift_start_time)
           *
    FROM cand_base
    ORDER BY kaipoke_cs_id, shift_start_date, shift_start_time,
             two_person_work_flg DESC,
             required_staff_count DESC,
             service_code ASC
  ),

  -- p_policy = 'delete_month_insert' → このCSのこの月を全削除
  del_month AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    WHERE p_policy = 'delete_month_insert'
      AND s.kaipoke_cs_id = p_cs_id
      AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
    RETURNING 1
  ),

  -- p_policy = 'overwrite_only' → 先に重なり分だけ削除
  del_overlap AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'overwrite_only'
      AND s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND s.shift_timerange && c.cand_range
    RETURNING 1
  ),

  -- 全ポリシー共通の挿入
  ins_all AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id, service_code,
      shift_start_date, shift_start_time, shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id, c.service_code,
      c.shift_start_date, c.shift_start_time, c.shift_end_time,
      c.required_staff_count, c.two_person_work_flg, c.judo_ido,
      c.staff_01_user_id, c.staff_02_user_id, c.staff_03_user_id,
      c.staff_02_attend_flg, c.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup c
    WHERE
      -- delete_month_insert / overwrite_only → 全部挿入
      p_policy IN ('delete_month_insert', 'overwrite_only')
      OR (
        -- skip_conflict → 既存と重なっていないものだけ挿入
        p_policy = 'skip_conflict'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.shift s2
          WHERE s2.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
            AND s2.shift_timerange && c.cand_range
        )
      )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
  )

  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_all), 0)
  INTO v_ins;

  RETURN v_ins;
END;
$function$

functions.name: deploy_weekly_template_bulk
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deploy_weekly_template_bulk(p_month text, p_policy text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_start date := (p_month || '-01')::date;
  v_end   date := (v_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;
  v_ins   int := 0;
  v_del   int := 0;
  v_prn   int := 0;  -- pruned count
BEGIN
  -- 念のためDB側のstatement_timeoutは延長（REST側の8〜10sは別枠）
  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '30s', true);

  WITH tmpl AS (
    SELECT * FROM public.shift_weekly_template t
    WHERE t.active = true
  ),
  days AS (
    SELECT g::date AS d
    FROM generate_series(v_start, v_end, interval '1 day') AS g
  ),
  cand_base AS (
    SELECT
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,
      d.d                                AS shift_start_date,
      t.start_time::time                 AS shift_start_time,
      t.end_time::time                   AS shift_end_time,
      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,
      t.staff_01_user_id, t.staff_02_user_id, t.staff_03_user_id,
      t.staff_02_attend_flg, t.staff_03_attend_flg,
      tsrange(
        (d.d::timestamp + t.start_time),
        (d.d::timestamp + t.end_time)
          + CASE WHEN t.end_time <= t.start_time THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '0' END,
        '[)'
      ) AS cand_range,
      CEIL(EXTRACT(day FROM d.d)/7.0)::int AS nth_week,
      -- ここは使わないが後続DELETEの照合用に保持
      t.is_biweekly,
      t.nth_weeks,
      t.weekday
    FROM tmpl t
    JOIN days d
      -- ISO曜日：月=1 … 日=7、テンプレが0(日)の可能性にも対応
      ON EXTRACT(isodow FROM d.d) = (CASE WHEN t.weekday = 0 THEN 7 ELSE t.weekday END)
  ),
  -- ★ 隔週フィルタはかけない（まず全候補を展開）
  cand AS (
    SELECT * FROM cand_base
  ),
  -- 同日・同時刻で重複候補を1件に絞る
  cand_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (kaipoke_cs_id, shift_start_date, shift_start_time)
           *
    FROM cand
    ORDER BY kaipoke_cs_id, shift_start_date, shift_start_time,
             two_person_work_flg DESC,
             required_staff_count DESC,
             service_code ASC
  ),

  -- 月全削除 → 全挿入
  del_month AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING (SELECT DISTINCT kaipoke_cs_id FROM tmpl) u
    WHERE p_policy = 'delete_month_insert'
      AND s.kaipoke_cs_id = u.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
    RETURNING 1
  ),
  ins_all AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id, service_code, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      kaipoke_cs_id, service_code, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup
    WHERE p_policy = 'delete_month_insert'
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
  ),

  -- 重なり分だけ削除 → 候補を挿入
  del_overlap AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'overwrite_only'
      AND s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND s.shift_timerange && c.cand_range
    RETURNING 1
  ),
  ins_overlap AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id, service_code, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      kaipoke_cs_id, service_code, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup
    WHERE p_policy = 'overwrite_only'
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
  ),

  -- 重なりが無い候補のみ挿入
  ins_skip AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id, service_code, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id, c.service_code, c.shift_start_date, c.shift_start_time, c.shift_end_time,
      c.required_staff_count, c.two_person_work_flg, c.judo_ido,
      c.staff_01_user_id, c.staff_02_user_id, c.staff_03_user_id,
      c.staff_02_attend_flg, c.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'skip_conflict'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.shift s
        WHERE s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
          AND s.shift_timerange && c.cand_range
      )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
  ),

  -- ★ ここから「非該当週」の一括削除（prune）
  prune_target AS (
    SELECT s.shift_id
    FROM public.shift s
    JOIN public.shift_weekly_template t
      ON t.active = TRUE
     AND t.kaipoke_cs_id = s.kaipoke_cs_id
     AND (CASE WHEN t.weekday = 0 THEN 7 ELSE t.weekday END) = EXTRACT(isodow FROM s.shift_start_date)
     AND t.start_time::time = s.shift_start_time
     AND COALESCE(t.service_code,'') = COALESCE(s.service_code,'')
    WHERE s.shift_start_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
      AND t.is_biweekly IS TRUE
      AND cardinality(t.nth_weeks::smallint[]) > 0
      AND NOT (
        CEIL(EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_start_date)/7.0)::smallint
          = ANY (t.nth_weeks::smallint[])
      )
  ),
  prune_del AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING prune_target x
    WHERE s.shift_id = x.shift_id
    RETURNING 1
  )

  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_all), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_overlap), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_skip), 0)              AS ins_cnt,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM del_overlap), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM del_month), 0)             AS del_cnt,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prune_del), 0)               AS prn_cnt
  INTO v_ins, v_del, v_prn;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'inserted_count', v_ins,
    'updated_count',  0,
    'deleted_count',  v_del,
    'pruned_count',   v_prn
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: deploy_weekly_template_bulk_test
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deploy_weekly_template_bulk_test(p_month text, p_policy text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_start date := (p_month || '-01')::date;
  v_end   date := (v_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;

  v_ins int := 0;
  v_del int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_month !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_month must be YYYY-MM format: %', p_month;
  END IF;

  IF p_policy NOT IN (
    'skip_conflict',
    'overwrite_only',
    'delete_month_insert'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid policy: %', p_policy;
  END IF;

  WITH tmpl AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM public.shift_weekly_template t
    WHERE t.active = true
  ),

  days AS (
    SELECT g::date AS d
    FROM generate_series(
      v_start,
      v_end,
      interval '1 day'
    ) AS g
  ),

  cand_base AS (
    SELECT
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,
      d.d AS shift_start_date,
      t.start_time::time AS shift_start_time,
      t.end_time::time AS shift_end_time,
      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,
      t.staff_01_user_id,
      t.staff_02_user_id,
      t.staff_03_user_id,
      t.staff_02_attend_flg,
      t.staff_03_attend_flg,

      tsrange(
        d.d::timestamp + t.start_time,
        d.d::timestamp
          + t.end_time
          + CASE
              WHEN t.end_time <= t.start_time
                THEN interval '1 day'
              ELSE interval '0'
            END,
        '[)'
      ) AS cand_range,

      CEIL(
        EXTRACT(day FROM d.d) / 7.0
      )::smallint AS nth_week,

      t.is_biweekly,
      t.nth_weeks,
      t.weekday

    FROM tmpl t
    JOIN days d
      ON EXTRACT(isodow FROM d.d)
         = CASE
             WHEN t.weekday = 0 THEN 7
             ELSE t.weekday
           END
  ),

  cand AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM cand_base
    WHERE
      is_biweekly IS NOT TRUE
      OR COALESCE(
        cardinality(nth_weeks::smallint[]),
        0
      ) = 0
      OR nth_week = ANY(
        nth_weeks::smallint[]
      )
  ),

  cand_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time
    )
      *
    FROM cand
    ORDER BY
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      two_person_work_flg DESC,
      required_staff_count DESC,
      service_code ASC
  ),

  del_month AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING (
      SELECT DISTINCT kaipoke_cs_id
      FROM tmpl
    ) u
    WHERE p_policy = 'delete_month_insert'
      AND s.kaipoke_cs_id = u.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end
    RETURNING s.shift_id
  ),

  ins_all AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      service_code,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count,
      two_person_work_flg,
      judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id,
      staff_02_user_id,
      staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg,
      staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id,
      c.service_code,
      c.shift_start_date,
      c.shift_start_time,
      c.shift_end_time,
      c.required_staff_count,
      c.two_person_work_flg,
      c.judo_ido,
      c.staff_01_user_id,
      c.staff_02_user_id,
      c.staff_03_user_id,
      c.staff_02_attend_flg,
      c.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'delete_month_insert'
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING shift_id
  ),

  del_overlap AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'overwrite_only'
      AND s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN
          c.shift_start_date - 1
          AND c.shift_start_date + 1
      AND s.shift_timerange && c.cand_range
    RETURNING s.shift_id
  ),

  ins_overlap AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      service_code,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count,
      two_person_work_flg,
      judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id,
      staff_02_user_id,
      staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg,
      staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id,
      c.service_code,
      c.shift_start_date,
      c.shift_start_time,
      c.shift_end_time,
      c.required_staff_count,
      c.two_person_work_flg,
      c.judo_ido,
      c.staff_01_user_id,
      c.staff_02_user_id,
      c.staff_03_user_id,
      c.staff_02_attend_flg,
      c.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'overwrite_only'
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING shift_id
  ),

  ins_skip AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      service_code,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count,
      two_person_work_flg,
      judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id,
      staff_02_user_id,
      staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg,
      staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id,
      c.service_code,
      c.shift_start_date,
      c.shift_start_time,
      c.shift_end_time,
      c.required_staff_count,
      c.two_person_work_flg,
      c.judo_ido,
      c.staff_01_user_id,
      c.staff_02_user_id,
      c.staff_03_user_id,
      c.staff_02_attend_flg,
      c.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM cand_dedup c
    WHERE p_policy = 'skip_conflict'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.shift s
        WHERE s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
          AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN
              c.shift_start_date - 1
              AND c.shift_start_date + 1
          AND s.shift_timerange && c.cand_range
      )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING shift_id
  )

  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_all), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_overlap), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_skip), 0),

    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM del_month), 0)
    + COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM del_overlap), 0)

  INTO
    v_ins,
    v_del;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'inserted_count', v_ins,
    'updated_count', 0,
    'deleted_count', v_del,
    'pruned_count', 0,
    'test_function', true,
    'month', p_month,
    'policy', p_policy
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: deploy_weekly_template_fixed_nth_only
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deploy_weekly_template_fixed_nth_only(p_month text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_candidate_count integer := 0;
  v_inserted_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_month IS NULL
     OR p_month !~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'p_month must be YYYY-MM format: %',
      p_month;
  END IF;

  v_start := (p_month || '-01')::date;
  v_end := (
    v_start
    + interval '1 month'
    - interval '1 day'
  )::date;

  WITH fixed_week_templates AS (
    SELECT
      t.template_id,
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,
      t.weekday,
      t.start_time::time AS start_time,
      t.end_time::time AS end_time,
      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,
      t.staff_01_user_id,
      t.staff_02_user_id,
      t.staff_03_user_id,
      t.staff_02_attend_flg,
      t.staff_03_attend_flg,
      t.nth_weeks::smallint[] AS nth_weeks
    FROM public.shift_weekly_template t
    WHERE t.active = true
      AND COALESCE(
        cardinality(t.nth_weeks::smallint[]),
        0
      ) > 0
  ),

  calendar_days AS (
    SELECT d::date AS shift_date
    FROM generate_series(
      v_start,
      v_end,
      interval '1 day'
    ) d
  ),

  candidates AS (
    SELECT
      t.template_id,
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,
      d.shift_date AS shift_start_date,
      t.start_time AS shift_start_time,
      t.end_time AS shift_end_time,
      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,
      t.staff_01_user_id,
      t.staff_02_user_id,
      t.staff_03_user_id,
      t.staff_02_attend_flg,
      t.staff_03_attend_flg,

      tsrange(
        d.shift_date::timestamp + t.start_time,
        d.shift_date::timestamp
          + t.end_time
          + CASE
              WHEN t.end_time <= t.start_time
                THEN interval '1 day'
              ELSE interval '0 day'
            END,
        '[)'
      ) AS candidate_range

    FROM fixed_week_templates t
    JOIN calendar_days d
      ON EXTRACT(isodow FROM d.shift_date)::integer
         =
         CASE
           WHEN t.weekday = 0 THEN 7
           ELSE t.weekday
         END

     AND CEIL(
           EXTRACT(day FROM d.shift_date) / 7.0
         )::smallint
         = ANY(t.nth_weeks)
  ),

  candidate_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS count
    FROM candidates
  ),

  inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      service_code,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,
      required_staff_count,
      two_person_work_flg,
      judo_ido,
      staff_01_user_id,
      staff_02_user_id,
      staff_03_user_id,
      staff_02_attend_flg,
      staff_03_attend_flg
    )
    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id,
      c.service_code,
      c.shift_start_date,
      c.shift_start_time,
      c.shift_end_time,
      c.required_staff_count,
      c.two_person_work_flg,
      c.judo_ido,
      c.staff_01_user_id,
      c.staff_02_user_id,
      c.staff_03_user_id,
      c.staff_02_attend_flg,
      c.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM candidates c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.shift s
      WHERE s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id
        AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN
            c.shift_start_date - 1
            AND c.shift_start_date + 1
        AND s.shift_timerange && c.candidate_range
    )
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING shift_id
  )

  SELECT
    cc.count,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
      FROM inserted
    )
  INTO
    v_candidate_count,
    v_inserted_count
  FROM candidate_count cc;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'function', 'deploy_weekly_template_fixed_nth_only',
    'month', p_month,
    'template_type', 'fixed_nth_weeks',
    'candidate_count', v_candidate_count,
    'inserted_count', v_inserted_count,
    'skipped_count',
      v_candidate_count - v_inserted_count
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: deploy_weekly_template_regular_only
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deploy_weekly_template_regular_only(p_month text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_start date;
  v_end date;

  v_template_count integer := 0;
  v_candidate_count integer := 0;
  v_inserted_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  /* 月指定の形式確認 */
  IF p_month IS NULL
     OR p_month !~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'p_month must be YYYY-MM format: %',
      p_month;
  END IF;

  v_start := (p_month || '-01')::date;

  v_end := (
    v_start
    + interval '1 month'
    - interval '1 day'
  )::date;

  WITH regular_templates AS (
    SELECT
      t.template_id,
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,
      t.weekday,
      t.start_time::time AS start_time,
      t.end_time::time AS end_time,

      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,

      t.staff_01_user_id,
      t.staff_02_user_id,
      t.staff_03_user_id,

      t.staff_02_attend_flg,
      t.staff_03_attend_flg

    FROM public.shift_weekly_template t

    WHERE t.active = true

      /* 連続隔週テンプレートを除外 */
      AND COALESCE(
            t.is_biweekly,
            false
          ) = false

      /* 指定週テンプレートを除外 */
      AND COALESCE(
            cardinality(
              t.nth_weeks::smallint[]
            ),
            0
          ) = 0
  ),

  calendar_days AS (
    SELECT
      d::date AS shift_date

    FROM generate_series(
      v_start,
      v_end,
      interval '1 day'
    ) AS d
  ),

  candidates AS (
    SELECT
      t.template_id,
      t.kaipoke_cs_id,
      t.service_code,

      d.shift_date AS shift_start_date,
      t.start_time AS shift_start_time,
      t.end_time AS shift_end_time,

      t.required_staff_count,
      t.two_person_work_flg,
      t.judo_ido,

      t.staff_01_user_id,
      t.staff_02_user_id,
      t.staff_03_user_id,

      t.staff_02_attend_flg,
      t.staff_03_attend_flg,

      tsrange(
        d.shift_date::timestamp
          + t.start_time,

        d.shift_date::timestamp
          + t.end_time
          + CASE
              WHEN t.end_time <= t.start_time
                THEN interval '1 day'
              ELSE interval '0 day'
            END,

        '[)'
      ) AS candidate_range

    FROM regular_templates t

    JOIN calendar_days d
      ON EXTRACT(
           isodow FROM d.shift_date
         )::integer
         =
         CASE
           /* 0を日曜日として保存している場合 */
           WHEN t.weekday = 0 THEN 7
           ELSE t.weekday
         END
  ),

  candidate_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,
      COALESCE(service_code, '')
    )
      *

    FROM candidates

    ORDER BY
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,
      COALESCE(service_code, ''),
      template_id
  ),

  counts AS (
    SELECT
      (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
        FROM regular_templates
      ) AS template_count,

      (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
        FROM candidate_dedup
      ) AS candidate_count
  ),

  inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.shift (
      kaipoke_cs_id,
      service_code,

      shift_start_date,
      shift_start_time,
      shift_end_time,

      required_staff_count,
      two_person_work_flg,
      judo_ido,

      staff_01_user_id,
      staff_02_user_id,
      staff_03_user_id,

      staff_02_attend_flg,
      staff_03_attend_flg
    )

    SELECT
      c.kaipoke_cs_id,
      c.service_code,

      c.shift_start_date,
      c.shift_start_time,
      c.shift_end_time,

      c.required_staff_count,
      c.two_person_work_flg,
      c.judo_ido,

      c.staff_01_user_id,
      c.staff_02_user_id,
      c.staff_03_user_id,

      c.staff_02_attend_flg,
      c.staff_03_attend_flg

    FROM candidate_dedup c

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1

      FROM public.shift s

      WHERE s.kaipoke_cs_id = c.kaipoke_cs_id

        /*
         * 日跨ぎシフトを考慮し、前後1日の範囲から
         * 同一利用者の重複シフトを確認
         */
        AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN
            c.shift_start_date - 1
            AND c.shift_start_date + 1

        AND s.shift_timerange && c.candidate_range
    )

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING shift_id
  )

  SELECT
    c.template_count,
    c.candidate_count,

    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
      FROM inserted
    )

  INTO
    v_template_count,
    v_candidate_count,
    v_inserted_count

  FROM counts c;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'function',
      'deploy_weekly_template_regular_only',
    'month', p_month,
    'template_type', 'regular_weekly_only',

    'template_count',
      v_template_count,

    'candidate_count',
      v_candidate_count,

    'inserted_count',
      v_inserted_count,

    'skipped_count',
      v_candidate_count
      - v_inserted_count
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: generate_shifts_from_templates
functions.identity_args: p_cs_id text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_shifts_from_templates(p_cs_id text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id text, shift_start_date date, shift_start_time time without time zone, shift_end_time time without time zone, service_code text, required_staff_count smallint, two_person_work_flg boolean, judo_ido text, staff_01_user_id text, staff_02_user_id text, staff_03_user_id text, staff_02_attend_flg boolean, staff_03_attend_flg boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH date_series AS (
        -- 期間内のすべての日付を生成
        SELECT generate_series(p_start_date, p_end_date, '1 day'::interval)::DATE AS d,
               EXTRACT(DOW FROM generate_series(p_start_date, p_end_date, '1 day'::interval))::SMALLINT AS dw,
               -- 第N週目の計算 (その月の1日からの経過週数)
               (EXTRACT(DAY FROM generate_series(p_start_date, p_end_date, '1 day'::interval)) - 1) / 7 + 1 AS nth_week
    )
    SELECT
        t.kaipoke_cs_id,
        ds.d AS shift_start_date,
        t.start_time,
        t.end_time,
        t.service_code,
        t.required_staff_count,
        t.two_person_work_flg,
        t.judo_ido,
        t.staff_01_user_id,
        t.staff_02_user_id,
        t.staff_03_user_id,
        t.staff_02_attend_flg,
        t.staff_03_attend_flg
    FROM
        date_series ds
    INNER JOIN
        shift_weekly_template t ON ds.dw = t.weekday
    WHERE
        t.kaipoke_cs_id = p_cs_id
        AND t.active = TRUE
        -- 有効期間チェック
        AND (t.effective_from IS NULL OR ds.d >= t.effective_from)
        AND (t.effective_to IS NULL OR ds.d <= t.effective_to)
        -- 隔週チェック (is_biweekly が true の場合、2週間サイクルで有効/無効を判定)
        AND (
            t.is_biweekly IS NULL OR t.is_biweekly = FALSE
            OR (
                t.is_biweekly = TRUE AND
                -- 1/1 からの日数で偶数週/奇数週を判定。テンプレート作成日の曜日を基準に調整が必要な場合もあるが、ここではシンプルに日付の連番で判定
                MOD((ds.d - '2023-01-01'::DATE) / 7, 2) = (t.template_id % 2) -- 仮のロジック。テンプレートIDで偶奇週の基準を決定
            )
        )
        -- 第N週チェック (nth_weeks が設定されている場合)
        AND (
            t.nth_weeks IS NULL 
            OR ds.nth_week = ANY(t.nth_weeks)
        );
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_candidate_clients_multi
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_candidate_clients_multi(p_office_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id text, client_name text, client_kana text, office_id bigint, office_name character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ci.kaipoke_cs_id, coo.id)
    ci.kaipoke_cs_id,
    ci.name AS client_name,
    ci.kana AS client_kana,
    coo.id AS office_id,
    coo.office_name
  FROM cm_kaipoke_info ci
  INNER JOIN cm_kaipoke_service_usage csu 
    ON ci.kaipoke_cs_id = csu.kaipoke_cs_id
  INNER JOIN cm_kaipoke_other_office coo 
    ON csu.office_number = coo.office_number
  WHERE coo.id = ANY(p_office_ids)
  ORDER BY ci.kaipoke_cs_id, coo.id, ci.kana;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_client_documents
functions.identity_args: p_kaipoke_cs_id character varying, p_limit integer, p_offset integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_client_documents(p_kaipoke_cs_id character varying, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(document_id bigint, fax_received_id bigint, fax_number character varying, fax_received_at timestamp with time zone, document_type_id bigint, document_type_name character varying, office_id bigint, office_name character varying, page_ids bigint[], page_numbers integer[], other_client_names character varying[], assigned_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    fd.id AS document_id,
    fd.fax_received_id,
    fr.fax_number,
    fr.received_at AS fax_received_at,
    fd.document_type_id,
    dt.name AS document_type_name,
    fd.office_id,
    coo.office_name,
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fdp.fax_page_id ORDER BY fdp.page_order)
      FROM cm_fax_document_pages fdp
      WHERE fdp.fax_document_id = fd.id
    ) AS page_ids,
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fp.page_number ORDER BY fdp2.page_order)
      FROM cm_fax_document_pages fdp2
      INNER JOIN cm_fax_pages fp ON fdp2.fax_page_id = fp.id
      WHERE fdp2.fax_document_id = fd.id
    ) AS page_numbers,
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fdc2.client_name)
      FROM cm_fax_document_clients fdc2
      WHERE fdc2.fax_document_id = fd.id
        AND fdc2.kaipoke_cs_id != p_kaipoke_cs_id
    ) AS other_client_names,
    fd.assigned_at
  FROM cm_fax_document_clients fdc
  INNER JOIN cm_fax_documents fd ON fdc.fax_document_id = fd.id
  INNER JOIN cm_fax_received fr ON fd.fax_received_id = fr.id
  LEFT JOIN cm_document_types dt ON fd.document_type_id = dt.id
  LEFT JOIN cm_kaipoke_other_office coo ON fd.office_id = coo.id
  WHERE fdc.kaipoke_cs_id = p_kaipoke_cs_id
    AND fd.assigned_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY fd.assigned_at DESC
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_clients_by_office
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_clients_by_office(p_office_number character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id character varying, name character varying, kana character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- 直近3ヶ月のサービス利用がある利用者を取得
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.kaipoke_cs_id,
    c.name,
    c.kana
  FROM cm_kaipoke_info c
  INNER JOIN cm_kaipoke_service_usage u ON c.kaipoke_cs_id = u.kaipoke_cs_id
  WHERE u.office_number = p_office_number
    AND u.service_year_month >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months', 'YYYY-MM')
  ORDER BY c.name
  LIMIT 50;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_fax_documents
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_fax_documents(p_fax_received_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(document_id bigint, document_type_id bigint, document_type_name character varying, office_id bigint, office_name character varying, is_advertisement boolean, is_cover_sheet boolean, requires_response boolean, response_deadline date, response_sent_at timestamp with time zone, client_ids character varying[], client_names character varying[], page_ids bigint[], page_numbers integer[], assigned_by character varying, assigned_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    fd.id AS document_id,
    fd.document_type_id,
    dt.name AS document_type_name,
    fd.office_id,
    coo.office_name,
    fd.is_advertisement,
    fd.is_cover_sheet,
    fd.requires_response,
    fd.response_deadline,
    fd.response_sent_at,
    -- 利用者情報（配列）
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fdc.kaipoke_cs_id ORDER BY fdc.is_primary DESC, fdc.id)
      FROM cm_fax_document_clients fdc
      WHERE fdc.fax_document_id = fd.id
    ) AS client_ids,
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fdc.client_name ORDER BY fdc.is_primary DESC, fdc.id)
      FROM cm_fax_document_clients fdc
      WHERE fdc.fax_document_id = fd.id
    ) AS client_names,
    -- ページ情報（配列）
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fdp.fax_page_id ORDER BY fdp.page_order)
      FROM cm_fax_document_pages fdp
      WHERE fdp.fax_document_id = fd.id
    ) AS page_ids,
    (
      SELECT ARRAY_AGG(fp.page_number ORDER BY fdp2.page_order)
      FROM cm_fax_document_pages fdp2
      INNER JOIN cm_fax_pages fp ON fdp2.fax_page_id = fp.id
      WHERE fdp2.fax_document_id = fd.id
    ) AS page_numbers,
    fd.assigned_by,
    fd.assigned_at
  FROM cm_fax_documents fd
  LEFT JOIN cm_document_types dt ON fd.document_type_id = dt.id
  LEFT JOIN cm_kaipoke_other_office coo ON fd.office_id = coo.id
  WHERE fd.fax_received_id = p_fax_received_id
  ORDER BY fd.sort_order, fd.id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_fax_processing_status
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_fax_processing_status(p_fax_received_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(total_pages integer, assigned_pages integer, total_documents integer, completion_rate numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(fr.page_count, 0)::INT AS total_pages,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fdp.fax_page_id)::INT
      FROM cm_fax_documents fd
      INNER JOIN cm_fax_document_pages fdp ON fd.id = fdp.fax_document_id
      WHERE fd.fax_received_id = p_fax_received_id
        AND fd.assigned_at IS NOT NULL
    ) AS assigned_pages,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::INT
      FROM cm_fax_documents fd
      WHERE fd.fax_received_id = p_fax_received_id
        AND fd.assigned_at IS NOT NULL
    ) AS total_documents,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(fr.page_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0::NUMERIC(5,2)
      ELSE ROUND(
        (
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fdp.fax_page_id)::NUMERIC
          FROM cm_fax_documents fd
          INNER JOIN cm_fax_document_pages fdp ON fd.id = fdp.fax_document_id
          WHERE fd.fax_received_id = p_fax_received_id
            AND fd.assigned_at IS NOT NULL
        ) / fr.page_count * 100, 2
      )::NUMERIC(5,2)
    END AS completion_rate
  FROM cm_fax_received fr
  WHERE fr.id = p_fax_received_id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_foreign_keys
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_foreign_keys(target_schema text, target_table text)
 RETURNS TABLE(column_name text, foreign_schema text, foreign_table text, foreign_column text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    select
        kcu.column_name::text,
        ccu.table_schema::text as foreign_schema,
        ccu.table_name::text as foreign_table,
        ccu.column_name::text as foreign_column
    from information_schema.table_constraints tc
    join information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
        on tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
        and tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
    join information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu
        on ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
    where tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
      and tc.table_schema = target_schema
      and tc.table_name = target_table;
$function$

functions.name: get_job_progress
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_job_progress(p_job_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(total integer, completed integer, failed integer, pending integer, progress_percent numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int as total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'completed')::int as completed,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'failed')::int as failed,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'pending')::int as pending,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'completed') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1)
    END as progress_percent
  FROM cm_job_items i
  WHERE i.job_id = p_job_id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_next_job
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_next_job(p_queue text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, queue text, job_type text, status text, payload jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_job_id bigint;
BEGIN
  -- 最も古いpendingジョブを取得してロック
  SELECT j.id INTO v_job_id
  FROM cm_jobs j
  WHERE j.queue = p_queue
    AND j.status = 'pending'
  ORDER BY j.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;

  -- ジョブが見つからない場合はNULLを返す
  IF v_job_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- ステータスをprocessingに更新
  UPDATE cm_jobs j
  SET status = 'processing'
  WHERE j.id = v_job_id;

  -- 更新されたジョブを返す
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT j.id, j.queue, j.job_type, j.status, j.payload, j.created_at
  FROM cm_jobs j
  WHERE j.id = v_job_id;
END;
$function$

    from information_schema.schemata s
    where s.schema_name not in ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast')

functions.name: get_schema_tables
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_schema_tables(target_schema text)
 RETURNS TABLE(table_schema text, table_name text, object_type text, table_comment text, column_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    select
        t.table_schema::text,
        t.table_name::text,
        case t.table_type
            when 'BASE TABLE' then 'TABLE'
            when 'VIEW' then 'VIEW'
            else t.table_type
        end::text as object_type,
        coalesce(obj_description(
            (quote_ident(t.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(t.table_name))::regclass
        ), '')::text as table_comment,
        (select count(*)
         from information_schema.columns c
         where c.table_schema = t.table_schema
           and c.table_name = t.table_name
        ) as column_count
    from information_schema.tables t
    where t.table_schema = target_schema
      and t.table_type in ('BASE TABLE', 'VIEW')
    order by
        case t.table_type when 'BASE TABLE' then 1 else 2 end,
        t.table_name;
$function$

functions.name: get_sender_pattern_suggestion
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sender_pattern_suggestion(p_office_id bigint, p_fax_number character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(sender_name character varying, page_order_pattern character varying, page_order_confidence numeric, rotation_patterns jsonb, avg_page_count numeric, total_fax_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  normalized_fax VARCHAR(20);
BEGIN
  normalized_fax := REGEXP_REPLACE(p_fax_number, '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    sp.sender_name,
    sp.page_order_pattern,
    sp.page_order_confidence,
    sp.rotation_patterns,
    sp.avg_page_count,
    sp.total_fax_count
  FROM cm_fax_sender_patterns sp
  WHERE (p_office_id IS NULL OR sp.office_id = p_office_id)
    AND (normalized_fax IS NULL OR normalized_fax = '' OR sp.fax_number = normalized_fax)
  ORDER BY sp.total_fax_count DESC
  LIMIT 5;
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    select
        c.column_name::text,
        c.data_type::text,
        c.udt_name::text,
        c.character_maximum_length::integer,
        c.numeric_precision::integer,
        c.numeric_scale::integer,
        c.is_nullable::text,
        c.column_default::text,
        coalesce(col_description(
            (quote_ident(c.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(c.table_name))::regclass,
            c.ordinal_position
        ), '')::text as column_comment
    from information_schema.columns c
    where c.table_schema = target_schema
      and c.table_name = target_table
    order by c.ordinal_position;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_office_pattern(p_office_id bigint, p_page_position character varying, p_doc_type_id bigint, p_is_ad boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_doc_type_counts JSONB;
  v_doc_type_key TEXT;
  v_current_count INT;
  v_max_doc_type_id BIGINT;
  v_max_count INT;
BEGIN
  v_doc_type_key := COALESCE(p_doc_type_id::TEXT, 'null');
  
  -- UPSERT: レコードがなければ作成、あれば更新
  INSERT INTO fax_office_patterns (
    office_id, page_position, total_count, ad_count, doc_type_counts
  )
  VALUES (
    p_office_id, p_page_position, 1,
    CASE WHEN p_is_ad THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    jsonb_build_object(v_doc_type_key, 1)
  )
  ON CONFLICT (office_id, page_position)
  DO UPDATE SET
    total_count = fax_office_patterns.total_count + 1,
    ad_count = fax_office_patterns.ad_count + CASE WHEN p_is_ad THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    doc_type_counts = CASE 
      WHEN fax_office_patterns.doc_type_counts ? v_doc_type_key THEN
        jsonb_set(
          fax_office_patterns.doc_type_counts,
          ARRAY[v_doc_type_key],
          to_jsonb((fax_office_patterns.doc_type_counts->>v_doc_type_key)::INT + 1)
        )
      ELSE
        fax_office_patterns.doc_type_counts || jsonb_build_object(v_doc_type_key, 1)
    END,
    updated_at = NOW();
  
  -- 最も多い文書種別を更新
  SELECT doc_type_counts INTO v_doc_type_counts
  FROM fax_office_patterns
  WHERE office_id = p_office_id AND page_position = p_page_position;
  
  -- JSONBから最大カウントの文書種別を取得
  SELECT key::BIGINT, value::INT INTO v_max_doc_type_id, v_max_count
  FROM jsonb_each_text(v_doc_type_counts)
  WHERE key != 'null'
  ORDER BY value::INT DESC
  LIMIT 1;
  
  -- most_common_* を更新
  UPDATE fax_office_patterns
  SET 
    most_common_doc_type_id = v_max_doc_type_id,
    most_common_confidence = CASE 
      WHEN total_count > 0 THEN (v_max_count::DECIMAL / total_count) * 100
      ELSE 0
    END
  WHERE office_id = p_office_id AND page_position = p_page_position;
  
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lookup_office_by_fax(p_fax_number character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, office_name character varying, fax character varying, fax_proxy character varying, service_type character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  normalized_input VARCHAR(20);
BEGIN
  -- 入力FAX番号を正規化（ハイフン・スペース除去）
  normalized_input := REGEXP_REPLACE(p_fax_number, '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  
  -- faxカラムで照合（ハイフン除去して比較）
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    o.id,
    o.office_name,
    o.fax,
    o.fax_proxy,
    o.service_type
  FROM cm_kaipoke_other_office o
  WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(o.fax, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = normalized_input
  LIMIT 1;
  
  -- 見つからなければfax_proxyで照合
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
      o.id,
      o.office_name,
      o.fax,
      o.fax_proxy,
      o.service_type
    FROM cm_kaipoke_other_office o
    WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(o.fax_proxy, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = normalized_input
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;
  
  RETURN;
END;
$function$

functions.name: lookup_offices_by_fax
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lookup_offices_by_fax(p_fax_number character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, office_name character varying, fax character varying, fax_proxy character varying, service_type character varying, office_number character varying, match_type character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  normalized_input VARCHAR(20);
BEGIN
  -- 入力FAX番号を正規化（ハイフン・スペース・カッコ除去）
  normalized_input := REGEXP_REPLACE(p_fax_number, '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  
  -- 入力が空の場合は空結果を返す
  IF normalized_input IS NULL OR normalized_input = '' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH matched_offices AS (
    -- 優先度1: fax完全一致
    SELECT 
      o.id, o.office_name, o.fax, o.fax_proxy, o.service_type, o.office_number,
      'fax_exact'::VARCHAR(20) AS match_type,
      1 AS priority
    FROM cm_kaipoke_other_office o
    WHERE o.fax IS NOT NULL AND o.fax = p_fax_number
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 優先度2: fax_proxy完全一致
    SELECT 
      o.id, o.office_name, o.fax, o.fax_proxy, o.service_type, o.office_number,
      'fax_proxy_exact'::VARCHAR(20) AS match_type,
      2 AS priority
    FROM cm_kaipoke_other_office o
    WHERE o.fax_proxy IS NOT NULL AND o.fax_proxy = p_fax_number
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 優先度3: fax正規化一致
    SELECT 
      o.id, o.office_name, o.fax, o.fax_proxy, o.service_type, o.office_number,
      'fax_normalized'::VARCHAR(20) AS match_type,
      3 AS priority
    FROM cm_kaipoke_other_office o
    WHERE o.fax IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.fax != p_fax_number  -- 完全一致は除外（重複防止）
      AND REGEXP_REPLACE(o.fax, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = normalized_input
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 優先度4: fax_proxy正規化一致
    SELECT 
      o.id, o.office_name, o.fax, o.fax_proxy, o.service_type, o.office_number,
      'fax_proxy_normalized'::VARCHAR(20) AS match_type,
      4 AS priority
    FROM cm_kaipoke_other_office o
    WHERE o.fax_proxy IS NOT NULL
      AND o.fax_proxy != p_fax_number  -- 完全一致は除外
      AND REGEXP_REPLACE(o.fax_proxy, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = normalized_input
  )
  -- 同一事業所が複数マッチした場合は優先度が高いものを採用
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (mo.id)
    mo.id, mo.office_name, mo.fax, mo.fax_proxy, mo.service_type, mo.office_number, mo.match_type
  FROM matched_offices mo
  ORDER BY mo.id, mo.priority;
END;
$function$

functions.name: normalize_shift_before_payroll
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_shift_before_payroll()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$declare
    v_cancel_item uuid := '2bd7eefb-3fb6-47fe-8684-1ac6f3ec530a'::uuid;
begin
    ---------------------------------------------
    -- ① 終了日がNULLなら開始日で補完
    ---------------------------------------------
    update public.shift s
       set shift_end_date = s.shift_start_date
     where s.shift_end_date is null
       and s.shift_start_date is not null;

    ---------------------------------------------
    -- ② shift/shift_records/shift_record_items に
    --    キャンセル（item_def=v_cancel_item）があるのに
    --    shift.service_code に「キャンセル」が含まれない場合：
    --    service_code を「キャンセル（手当発生・請求有）」に更新
    --    （※「キャンセル」と分かる表記を保証）
    ---------------------------------------------
    with canceled_shift as (
        select distinct s.shift_id
        from public.shift s
        join public.shift_records sr
          on sr.shift_id = s.shift_id
        join public.shift_record_items sri
          on sri.record_id = sr.id
        where sri.item_def_id = v_cancel_item
              -- value_text が '0' 以外（NULL含む）をキャンセル有りとして扱う
              and coalesce(sri.value_text, '1') <> '0'
    )
    update public.shift s
       set service_code = 'キャンセル（手当発生・請求有）'
     where s.shift_id in (select shift_id from canceled_shift)
       and (s.service_code is null or s.service_code not ilike '%キャンセル%');

    ---------------------------------------------
    -- ③ service_code に「キャンセル」を含む場合、
    --    shift_end_time = shift_start_time をセット
    ---------------------------------------------
    update public.shift s
       set shift_end_time = s.shift_start_time
     where s.service_code ilike '%キャンセル%'
       and s.shift_start_time is not null
       and (s.shift_end_time is distinct from s.shift_start_time);

end;$function$

functions.name: preview_shift_weekly_template_month
functions.identity_args: p_month text, p_kaipoke_cs_id text, p_use_recurrence boolean
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preview_shift_weekly_template_month(p_month text, p_kaipoke_cs_id text, p_use_recurrence boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id text, shift_start_date date, shift_start_time time without time zone, shift_end_time time without time zone, service_code text, required_staff_count smallint, two_person_work_flg boolean, judo_ido text, staff_01_user_id text, staff_02_user_id text, staff_03_user_id text, staff_02_attend_flg boolean, staff_03_attend_flg boolean, staff_01_role_code text, staff_02_role_code text, staff_03_role_code text, has_conflict boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
WITH b AS (
  SELECT to_date(p_month,'YYYY-MM') AS d0,
         (to_date(p_month,'YYYY-MM') + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date AS d1
),
days AS (
  SELECT g::date AS d
  FROM b, generate_series((SELECT d0 FROM b),(SELECT d1 FROM b),'1 day') g
),
tpl AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.shift_weekly_template
  WHERE active
    AND kaipoke_cs_id = p_kaipoke_cs_id
    AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= (SELECT d1 FROM b))
    AND (effective_to   IS NULL OR effective_to   >= (SELECT d0 FROM b))
),
cand AS (
  SELECT
    t.kaipoke_cs_id,
    d.d                  AS shift_start_date,
    t.start_time         AS shift_start_time,
    t.end_time           AS shift_end_time,
    t.service_code,
    t.required_staff_count, t.two_person_work_flg, t.judo_ido,
    t.staff_01_user_id, t.staff_02_user_id, t.staff_03_user_id,
    t.staff_02_attend_flg, t.staff_03_attend_flg,
    t.staff_01_role_code, t.staff_02_role_code, t.staff_03_role_code
  FROM tpl t
  JOIN days d
    ON EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.d)::int = t.weekday
  WHERE
    -- p_use_recurrence=TRUE のときだけ隔週/第n週を評価
    (
      NOT p_use_recurrence
      OR (
          (t.is_biweekly IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
           OR ((d.d - COALESCE(t.effective_from, d.d))::int / 7) % 2 = 0)
        AND (t.nth_weeks IS NULL
             OR (FLOOR((EXTRACT(DAY FROM d.d)::int-1)/7)+1)::int = ANY(t.nth_weeks))
      )
    )
)
SELECT
  c.*,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.shift z
    WHERE z.kaipoke_cs_id    = c.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND z.shift_start_date = c.shift_start_date
      AND z.shift_start_time < c.shift_end_time
      AND z.shift_end_time   > c.shift_start_time
  ) AS has_conflict
FROM cand c
ORDER BY c.shift_start_date, c.shift_start_time;
$function$

functions.name: prune_biweekly_nthweeks
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prune_biweekly_nthweeks(p_month text, p_cs_id text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_start date := (p_month || '-01')::date;
  v_end   date := (v_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;
  v_del   int;
BEGIN
  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','30s', true);

  WITH del AS (
    DELETE FROM public.shift s
    USING public.shift_weekly_template t
    WHERE
      -- 範囲・CS
      s.kaipoke_cs_id = p_cs_id
      AND s.shift_start_date BETWEEN v_start AND v_end

      -- テンプレへ等値JOIN（インデックス効きやすい）
      AND t.active = TRUE
      AND t.kaipoke_cs_id = s.kaipoke_cs_id
      AND t.weekday = EXTRACT(DOW FROM s.shift_start_date)::int   -- 0(日)..6(土)
      AND t.start_time::time = s.shift_start_time
      AND t.required_staff_count = s.required_staff_count

      -- 期間条件
      AND (t.effective_from IS NULL OR s.shift_start_date >= t.effective_from)
      AND (t.effective_to   IS NULL OR s.shift_start_date <= t.effective_to)

      -- 隔週テンプレのみ
      AND t.is_biweekly IS TRUE

      -- 第n週指定が空→制限なし（=削除しない）。指定あり→“含まれない”週を削除
      AND cardinality(t.nth_weeks::smallint[]) > 0
      AND NOT (
        -- 第n◯曜日：1-7=1, 8-14=2, 15-21=3, 22-28=4, 29-末=5
        (((EXTRACT(DAY FROM s.shift_start_date)::int - 1) / 7) + 1)::smallint
          = ANY (t.nth_weeks::smallint[])
      )
    RETURNING 1
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_del FROM del;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_del, 0);
END;
$function$
