functions.name: rebuild_staff_monthly_stats
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebuild_staff_monthly_stats(p_from date DEFAULT '2025-07-01'::date, p_to date DEFAULT (date_trunc('month'::text, timezone('Asia/Tokyo'::text, now())))::date)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_month date;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_from > p_to then
    raise exception 'p_from must be on or before p_to';
  end if;

  for v_month in
    select generate_series(date_trunc('month', p_from)::date, date_trunc('month', p_to)::date, interval '1 month')::date
  loop
    with eligible_shift_participants as (
      select s.shift_start_date::date as shift_date, participant.staff_user_id
      from shift_shift_record_view s
      cross join lateral (values
        (s.staff_01_user_id, true),
        (s.staff_02_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false)),
        (s.staff_03_user_id, not coalesce(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false))
      ) participant(staff_user_id, is_service_staff)
      where s.shift_start_date < (timezone('Asia/Tokyo', now())::date + 1)
        and coalesce(s.kaipoke_cs_id, '') not like '99999999%'
        and coalesce(s.service_code, '') not like '%キャンセル%'
        and participant.is_service_staff
        and nullif(btrim(participant.staff_user_id), '') is not null
        and s.shift_start_time is not null and s.shift_end_time is not null
    ), last_valid_shift as (
      select staff_user_id, max(shift_date) as last_shift_date
      from eligible_shift_participants
      group by staff_user_id
    ), staff as (
      select distinct on (u.user_id)
        u.user_id,
        coalesce(u.entry_date_latest, fe.agreed_at, fe.created_at, u.created_at)::timestamptz as hired_at,
        case when lower(btrim(coalesce(u.status, ''))) = 'removed_from_lineworks_kaipoke'
          then lvs.last_shift_date::timestamptz
        end as retired_at,
        lower(btrim(coalesce(u.system_role, u.role, ''))) as staff_role
      from users u
      join last_valid_shift lvs on lvs.staff_user_id = u.user_id
      left join form_entries fe on fe.id = u.entry_id
      where nullif(btrim(coalesce(u.user_id, '')), '') is not null
        and coalesce(u.org_unit_id, '') not in ('fb9bab81-5f4e-4725-2d34-05240f80a71a', '5b26013b-a3d4-42ab-266c-05cad5ab1c10')
      order by u.user_id, u.created_at desc nulls last
    ), counts as (
      select
        count(*) filter (where hired_at >= v_month and hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month')::integer as hired_count,
        count(*) filter (where retired_at >= v_month and retired_at < v_month + interval '1 month')::integer as retired_count,
        count(*) filter (where hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month'))::integer as active_count,
        count(*) filter (where hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month') and staff_role in ('manager', 'admin'))::integer as fulltime_count,
        count(*) filter (where hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month') and staff_role not in ('manager', 'admin'))::integer as other_count,
        count(*) filter (where user_id in (select staff_user_id from eligible_shift_participants where shift_date >= v_month and shift_date < (v_month + interval '1 month')::date) and hired_at < v_month + interval '1 month' and (retired_at is null or retired_at >= v_month + interval '1 month'))::integer as working_count
      from staff
    )
    insert into staff_monthly_stats (month, hired_count, retired_count, active_count, fulltime_count, other_count, working_count, calculated_at, updated_at)
    select v_month, hired_count, retired_count, active_count, fulltime_count, other_count, working_count, now(), now() from counts
    on conflict (month) do update set
      hired_count = excluded.hired_count, retired_count = excluded.retired_count,
      active_count = excluded.active_count, fulltime_count = excluded.fulltime_count,
      other_count = excluded.other_count, working_count = excluded.working_count,
      calculated_at = excluded.calculated_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

functions.name: refresh_disability_check_jisseki_staff
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_disability_check_jisseki_staff(_base_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  -- 基準日の属する月の月初
  v_base_month date := date_trunc('month', _base_date)::date;
begin
  /*
    1) 対象となる year_month（当月 + 翌月）を作る
    2) cs_kaipoke_info から「障害 or 移動支援」で実績担当者が設定されている利用者を取り出す
    3) disability_check に対して UPSERT（INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE）
  */

  with target_months as (
    select to_char(v_base_month, 'YYYY-MM') as year_month
    union all
    select to_char(v_base_month + interval '1 month', 'YYYY-MM') as year_month
  ),
  src as (
    select
      c.kaipoke_cs_id,
      c.asigned_jisseki_staff,
      c.service_kind as kaipoke_servicek,
      tm.year_month
    from public.cs_kaipoke_info c
    cross join target_months tm
    where c.asigned_jisseki_staff is not null
      -- disability_check_servicek_check を満たすため
      and c.service_kind in ('障害', '移動支援')
      -- 任意：有効な利用者だけに絞りたい場合は、必要に応じて条件を追加
      -- and coalesce(c.is_active, true)
  )
  insert into public.disability_check (
    kaipoke_cs_id,
    kaipoke_servicek,
    year_month,
    asigned_jisseki_staff
  )
  select
    s.kaipoke_cs_id,
    s.kaipoke_servicek,
    s.year_month,
    s.asigned_jisseki_staff
  from src s
  on conflict (kaipoke_cs_id, year_month, kaipoke_servicek)
  do update
    set asigned_jisseki_staff = excluded.asigned_jisseki_staff;

end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_fax_document(p_fax_received_id bigint, p_page_ids bigint[], p_document_type_id bigint, p_client_ids character varying[], p_client_names character varying[], p_office_id bigint, p_is_advertisement boolean DEFAULT false, p_is_cover_sheet boolean DEFAULT false, p_requires_response boolean DEFAULT false, p_response_deadline date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_assigned_by character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_suggested_document_type_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_suggested_confidence numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_document_id BIGINT;
  v_page_id BIGINT;
  v_page_order INT := 1;
  v_client_index INT;
  v_suggestion_was_correct BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  -- 入力チェック
  IF p_fax_received_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', FALSE, 'error', 'fax_received_id is required');
  END IF;
  
  -- 推定正解判定（文書種別のみで判定）
  v_suggestion_was_correct := (
    p_suggested_document_type_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND p_document_type_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND p_suggested_document_type_id = p_document_type_id
  );
  
  -- 書類を作成
  INSERT INTO cm_fax_documents (
    fax_received_id,
    document_type_id,
    office_id,
    is_advertisement,
    is_cover_sheet,
    requires_response,
    response_deadline,
    suggested_document_type_id,
    suggested_confidence,
    suggestion_was_correct,
    confidence_at_approval,
    assigned_by,
    assigned_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_fax_received_id,
    p_document_type_id,
    p_office_id,
    COALESCE(p_is_advertisement, FALSE),
    COALESCE(p_is_cover_sheet, FALSE),
    COALESCE(p_requires_response, FALSE),
    p_response_deadline,
    p_suggested_document_type_id,
    p_suggested_confidence,
    v_suggestion_was_correct,
    p_suggested_confidence,
    p_assigned_by,
    NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_document_id;
  
  -- 利用者を紐付け（複数）
  IF p_client_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(p_client_ids, 1) > 0 THEN
    FOR v_client_index IN 1..array_length(p_client_ids, 1)
    LOOP
      INSERT INTO cm_fax_document_clients (
        fax_document_id,
        kaipoke_cs_id,
        client_name,
        is_primary,
        source
      ) VALUES (
        v_document_id,
        p_client_ids[v_client_index],
        CASE 
          WHEN p_client_names IS NOT NULL AND v_client_index <= COALESCE(array_length(p_client_names, 1), 0)
          THEN p_client_names[v_client_index]
          ELSE NULL
        END,
        v_client_index = 1,  -- 最初の利用者をprimaryに
        'manual'
      )
      ON CONFLICT (fax_document_id, kaipoke_cs_id) DO NOTHING;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  
  -- ページを紐付け
  IF p_page_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(p_page_ids, 1) > 0 THEN
    FOREACH v_page_id IN ARRAY p_page_ids
    LOOP
      INSERT INTO cm_fax_document_pages (
        fax_document_id,
        fax_page_id,
        page_order
      ) VALUES (
        v_document_id,
        v_page_id,
        v_page_order
      )
      ON CONFLICT (fax_document_id, fax_page_id) DO NOTHING;
      
      v_page_order := v_page_order + 1;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  
  -- 結果を返却
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'document_id', v_document_id,
    'page_count', COALESCE(array_length(p_page_ids, 1), 0),
    'client_count', COALESCE(array_length(p_client_ids, 1), 0),
    'suggestion_was_correct', v_suggestion_was_correct
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_clients(p_query character varying, p_office_ids bigint[] DEFAULT NULL::bigint[], p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(kaipoke_cs_id character varying, client_name character varying, client_kana character varying, care_level character varying, office_id bigint, office_name character varying)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- 検索クエリが空の場合は空結果
  IF p_query IS NULL OR TRIM(p_query) = '' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ci.kaipoke_cs_id)
    ci.kaipoke_cs_id,
    ci.name AS client_name,
    ci.kana AS client_kana,
    ci.care_level,
    csu.office_id,
    coo.office_name
  FROM cm_kaipoke_info ci
  LEFT JOIN cm_kaipoke_service_usage csu ON ci.kaipoke_cs_id = csu.kaipoke_cs_id
  LEFT JOIN cm_kaipoke_other_office coo ON csu.office_id = coo.id
  WHERE 
    (ci.name ILIKE '%' || TRIM(p_query) || '%' OR ci.kana ILIKE '%' || TRIM(p_query) || '%')
    AND (p_office_ids IS NULL OR csu.office_id = ANY(p_office_ids))
  ORDER BY ci.kaipoke_cs_id, ci.name
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shift_fix_for_mfcloud()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cancel_item  uuid := '2bd7eefb-3fb6-47fe-8684-1ac6f3ec530a';
  v_fix_end_date int  := 0;
  v_mark_cancel  int  := 0;
  v_align_time   int  := 0;
BEGIN
  ---------------------------------------------
  -- ① 終了日がNULLなら開始日で補完
  ---------------------------------------------
  UPDATE public.shift s
     SET shift_end_date = s.shift_start_date
   WHERE s.shift_end_date IS NULL
     AND s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_fix_end_date = ROW_COUNT;

  ---------------------------------------------
  -- ② shift/shift_records/shift_record_items に
  --    キャンセル（item_def=v_cancel_item）があるのに
  --    shift.service_code に「キャンセル」が含まれない場合：
  --    service_code を「キャンセル（手当発生・請求有）」に更新
  ---------------------------------------------
  WITH canceled_shift AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.shift_id
    FROM public.shift s
    JOIN public.shift_records      sr  ON sr.shift_id  = s.shift_id
    JOIN public.shift_record_items sri ON sri.record_id = sr.id
    WHERE sri.item_def_id = v_cancel_item
      -- value_text が '0' 以外（NULL含む）をキャンセル有りとして扱う
      AND COALESCE(sri.value_text, '1') <> '0'
  )
  UPDATE public.shift s
     SET service_code = 'キャンセル（手当発生・請求有）'
   WHERE s.shift_id IN (SELECT shift_id FROM canceled_shift)
     AND (s.service_code IS NULL OR s.service_code NOT ILIKE '%キャンセル%');

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_mark_cancel = ROW_COUNT;

  ---------------------------------------------
  -- ③ service_code に「キャンセル」を含む場合、
  --    shift_end_time = shift_start_time をセット（= 0時間扱い）
  ---------------------------------------------
  UPDATE public.shift s
     SET shift_end_time = s.shift_start_time
   WHERE s.service_code ILIKE '%キャンセル%'
     AND s.shift_start_time IS NOT NULL
     AND (s.shift_end_time IS DISTINCT FROM s.shift_start_time);

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_align_time = ROW_COUNT;

  ---------------------------------------------
  -- まとめて件数を返す
  ---------------------------------------------
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'fixed_end_date_rows', v_fix_end_date,
    'marked_cancel_rows',  v_mark_cancel,
    'aligned_time_rows',   v_align_time
  );
END;
$function$

    service_code,
    staff_01_user_id,
    staff_02_user_id,
    staff_02_attend_flg,
    staff_03_user_id,
    staff_03_attend_flg,
    required_staff_count,
    two_person_work_flg,
    staff_01_role_code,
    staff_02_role_code,
    staff_03_role_code,

  )
  values (
    p_row->>'kaipoke_cs_id',
    (p_row->>'shift_start_date')::date,
    (p_row->>'shift_start_time')::time,
    nullif(p_row->>'shift_end_date','')::date,
    nullif(p_row->>'shift_end_time','')::time,
    p_row->>'service_code',
    p_row->>'staff_01_user_id',
    p_row->>'staff_02_user_id',
    coalesce((p_row->>'staff_02_attend_flg')::boolean, false),
    p_row->>'staff_03_user_id',
    coalesce((p_row->>'staff_03_attend_flg')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_row->>'required_staff_count')::integer, 1),
    coalesce((p_row->>'two_person_work_flg')::boolean, false),
    p_row->>'staff_01_role_code',
    p_row->>'staff_02_role_code',
    p_row->>'staff_03_role_code',
    p_row->>'judo_ido',

  return v_shift_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shift_update_with_context(p_shift_id bigint, p_patch jsonb, p_actor_user_id text, p_request_path text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  perform set_config('app.actor_user_id', coalesce(p_actor_user_id,''), true);
  perform set_config('app.request_path', coalesce(p_request_path,''), true);

  update public.shift s
  set
    shift_start_date =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_start_date' then (p_patch->>'shift_start_date')::date else s.shift_start_date end,
    shift_end_date   =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_end_date' then (p_patch->>'shift_end_date')::date else s.shift_end_date end,
    shift_start_time =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_start_time' then (p_patch->>'shift_start_time')::time else s.shift_start_time end,
    shift_end_time   =
      case when p_patch ? 'shift_end_time' then (p_patch->>'shift_end_time')::time else s.shift_end_time end,

    service_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'service_code' then (p_patch->>'service_code') else s.service_code end,

    staff_01_user_id =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_01_user_id' then (p_patch->>'staff_01_user_id') else s.staff_01_user_id end,
    staff_02_user_id =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_02_user_id' then (p_patch->>'staff_02_user_id') else s.staff_02_user_id end,
    staff_03_user_id =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_03_user_id' then (p_patch->>'staff_03_user_id') else s.staff_03_user_id end,

    staff_01_role_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_01_role_code' then (p_patch->>'staff_01_role_code') else s.staff_01_role_code end,
    staff_02_role_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_02_role_code' then (p_patch->>'staff_02_role_code') else s.staff_02_role_code end,
    staff_03_role_code =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_03_role_code' then (p_patch->>'staff_03_role_code') else s.staff_03_role_code end,

    judo_ido =
      case when p_patch ? 'judo_ido' then (p_patch->>'judo_ido') else s.judo_ido end,

    tokutei_comment =
      case when p_patch ? 'tokutei_comment' then (p_patch->>'tokutei_comment') else s.tokutei_comment end,

    staff_02_attend_flg =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_02_attend_flg' then (p_patch->>'staff_02_attend_flg')::boolean else s.staff_02_attend_flg end,
    staff_03_attend_flg =
      case when p_patch ? 'staff_03_attend_flg' then (p_patch->>'staff_03_attend_flg')::boolean else s.staff_03_attend_flg end,

    required_staff_count =
      case when p_patch ? 'required_staff_count' then (p_patch->>'required_staff_count')::integer else s.required_staff_count end,
    two_person_work_flg =
      case when p_patch ? 'two_person_work_flg' then (p_patch->>'two_person_work_flg')::boolean else s.two_person_work_flg end

  where s.shift_id = p_shift_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: snapshot_biz_stats_defect_sum
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_biz_stats_defect_sum(p_year_month text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$declare v_month_start date;

v_from_month date;

v_to_month_excl date;

v_affected integer;

begin
-- YYYYMM / YYYY-MM 両対応
if position('-' in p_year_month) > 0 then v_month_start := to_date(p_year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD');

else v_month_start := to_date(p_year_month || '01', 'YYYYMMDD');

end if;

v_from_month := (v_month_start - interval '2 month')::date;

v_to_month_excl := (v_month_start + interval '1 month')::date;

-- ✅ 当月スナップショットは作り直し
delete from public.biz_stats_defect_sum
where
  metric = 'team_lv5_defect_count'
  and snapshot_month = v_month_start;

with
  target_months as (
    select
      generate_series(v_from_month, v_month_start, interval '1 month')::date as month_start
  ),
  base_alerts as (
    select
      a.*,
      (a.created_at + interval '10 days') as basis_ts,
      date_trunc('month', (a.created_at + interval '10 days'))::date as month_start,
      to_char(
        date_trunc('month', (a.created_at + interval '10 days')),
        'YYYYMM'
      ) as year_month,
      coalesce(a.assigned_org_id::text, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from
      public.alert_log a
    where
      a.created_at is not null
      and (a.created_at + interval '10 days') >= v_from_month
      and (a.created_at + interval '10 days') < v_to_month_excl
      and a.severity::text in ('5', 'Lv5', 'LV5')
  ),
  -- ===== Lv3（orgunitid） =====
  monthly_lv3 as (
    select
      tm.month_start,
      to_char(tm.month_start, 'YYYYMM') as year_month,
      ba.orgunitid,
      coalesce(count(ba.id), 0)::numeric as defect_count
    from
      target_months tm
      left join base_alerts ba on ba.month_start = tm.month_start
    group by
      tm.month_start,
      ba.orgunitid
  ),
  monthly_lv3_named as (
    select
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      m.orgunitid,
      coalesce(
        o.orgunitname,
        case
          when m.orgunitid = 'UNASSIGNED' then '未割当'
          else m.orgunitid
        end
      ) as orgunitname,
      m.defect_count
    from
      monthly_lv3 m
      left join public.orgs o on o.orgunitid = m.orgunitid
  ),
  -- ===== Lv2（orgs_sort.lv2_id） =====
  monthly_lv2 as (
    select
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      os.lv2_id as orgunitid,
      max(os.lv2_name) as orgunitname,
      sum(m.defect_count)::numeric as defect_count
    from
      monthly_lv3_named m
      join public.orgs_sort os on os.orgunitid = m.orgunitid
    where
      os.lv2_id is not null
      and m.orgunitid <> 'UNASSIGNED'
      and os.orgunitid <> os.lv2_id
    group by
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      os.lv2_id
  ),
  monthly_total as (
    select
      month_start,
      year_month,
      'TOTAL' as orgunitid,
      'total' as orgunitname,
      sum(defect_count)::numeric as defect_count
    from
      monthly_lv3_named
    group by
      month_start,
      year_month
  ),
  unioned as (
    select
      *
    from
      monthly_lv2
    union all
    select
      *
    from
      monthly_lv3_named
    union all
    select
      *
    from
      monthly_total
  ),
  with_avg as (
    select
      u.*,
      round(
        avg(u.defect_count) over (
          partition by
            u.orgunitid
          order by
            u.month_start rows between 2 preceding
            and current row
        )::numeric,
        2
      ) as avg_3m_count
    from
      unioned u
  )
insert into
  public.biz_stats_defect_sum (
    metric,
    snapshot_month,
    year_month,
    orgunitid,
    orgunitname,
    value,
    avg_3m,
    snapshot_at,
    meta
  )
select
  'team_lv5_defect_count' as metric,
  v_month_start as snapshot_month,
  w.year_month,
  w.orgunitid,
  w.orgunitname,
  w.defect_count as value,
  w.avg_3m_count as avg_3m,
  now() as snapshot_at,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'source',
    'alert_log severity Lv5 by updated_at (lv3 + lv2 aggregated)',
    'range_from',
    to_char(v_from_month, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'range_to_excl',
    to_char(v_to_month_excl, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  ) as meta
from
  with_avg w
where
  w.month_start = v_month_start;

get diagnostics v_affected = row_count;

return v_affected;

end;$function$

functions.name: snapshot_biz_stats_shift_sum
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_biz_stats_shift_sum(p_year_month text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_month_start date;
  v_from_month date;
  v_to_month_excl date;
  v_affected integer;
begin
  if position('-' in p_year_month) > 0 then
    v_month_start := to_date(p_year_month || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD');
  else
    v_month_start := to_date(p_year_month || '01', 'YYYYMMDD');
  end if;

  v_from_month := (v_month_start - interval '2 month')::date;
  v_to_month_excl := (v_month_start + interval '1 month')::date;

  -- ✅ 当月は作り直し
  delete from public.biz_stats_shift_sum
  where metric = 'team_service_hours'
    and snapshot_month = v_month_start;

  with
  target_months as (
    select generate_series(v_from_month, v_month_start, interval '1 month')::date as month_start
  ),
  base_shifts as (
    select
      s.*,
      date_trunc('month', s.shift_start_date::timestamptz)::date as month_start,
      to_char(date_trunc('month', s.shift_start_date::timestamptz), 'YYYYMM') as year_month,
      extract(epoch from upper(s.shift_timerange) - lower(s.shift_timerange)) / 3600.0 as shift_hours
    from shift s
    where
      s.shift_start_date is not null
      and s.shift_start_time is not null
      and s.shift_end_time is not null
      and s.shift_start_date >= v_from_month
      and s.shift_start_date <  v_to_month_excl
      and s.kaipoke_cs_id !~~ '99999999%'
      and (s.service_code is null or s.service_code !~~* '%キャンセル%')
  ),

  participants as (
    -- staff_01
    select
      b.month_start,
      b.year_month,
      b.shift_hours,
      coalesce(u.org_unit_id, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from base_shifts b
    left join user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = b.staff_01_user_id
    where nullif(b.staff_01_user_id, '') is not null

    union all

    -- staff_02（attend_flg=true は除外）
    select
      b.month_start,
      b.year_month,
      b.shift_hours,
      coalesce(u.org_unit_id, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from base_shifts b
    left join user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = b.staff_02_user_id
    where
      nullif(b.staff_02_user_id, '') is not null
      and coalesce(b.staff_02_attend_flg, false) = false

    union all

    -- staff_03（attend_flg=true は除外）
    select
      b.month_start,
      b.year_month,
      b.shift_hours,
      coalesce(u.org_unit_id, 'UNASSIGNED') as orgunitid
    from base_shifts b
    left join user_entry_united_view_single u
      on u.user_id = b.staff_03_user_id
    where
      nullif(b.staff_03_user_id, '') is not null
      and coalesce(b.staff_03_attend_flg, false) = false
  ),

  -- ===== Lv3集計（従来） =====
  monthly_lv3 as (
    select
      tm.month_start,
      to_char(tm.month_start, 'YYYYMM') as year_month,
      p.orgunitid,
      round(coalesce(sum(p.shift_hours), 0)::numeric, 2) as total_hours
    from target_months tm
    left join participants p
      on p.month_start = tm.month_start
    group by tm.month_start, p.orgunitid
  ),

  monthly_lv3_named as (
    select
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      m.orgunitid,
      coalesce(o.orgunitname, case when m.orgunitid='UNASSIGNED' then '未割当' else m.orgunitid end) as orgunitname,
      m.total_hours
    from monthly_lv3 m
    left join orgs o on o.orgunitid = m.orgunitid
  ),

  -- ===== Lv2集計（NEW） =====
  monthly_lv2 as (
    select
      m.month_start,
      m.year_month,
      os.lv2_id as orgunitid,
      max(os.lv2_name) as orgunitname,
      round(sum(m.total_hours)::numeric, 2) as total_hours
    from monthly_lv3_named m
    join orgs_sort os
      on os.orgunitid = m.orgunitid
    where
      os.lv2_id is not null
      and m.orgunitid <> 'UNASSIGNED'
      and os.orgunitid <> os.lv2_id          -- Lv2自身の行を二重にしない（保険）
    group by m.month_start, m.year_month, os.lv2_id
  ),

  monthly_total as (
    select
      month_start,
      year_month,
      'TOTAL' as orgunitid,
      'total' as orgunitname,
      round(sum(total_hours)::numeric, 2) as total_hours
    from monthly_lv3_named
    group by month_start, year_month
  ),

  unioned as (
    -- ✅ Lv2 → Lv3 → TOTAL（表示側で並べ替えるので順序自体はどっちでもOK）
    select * from monthly_lv2
    union all
    select * from monthly_lv3_named
    union all
    select * from monthly_total
  ),

  with_avg as (
    select
      u.*,
      round(
        avg(u.total_hours) over (
          partition by u.orgunitid
          order by u.month_start
          rows between 2 preceding and current row
        )::numeric,
        2
      ) as avg_3m_hours
    from unioned u
  )

  insert into public.biz_stats_shift_sum (
    metric, snapshot_month, year_month, orgunitid, orgunitname, value, avg_3m, snapshot_at, meta
  )
  select
    'team_service_hours' as metric,
    v_month_start as snapshot_month,
    w.year_month,
    w.orgunitid,
    w.orgunitname,
    w.total_hours as value,
    w.avg_3m_hours as avg_3m,
    now() as snapshot_at,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'shift staff team (lv3 + lv2 aggregated)',
      'range_from', to_char(v_from_month, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'range_to', to_char(v_month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    ) as meta
  from with_avg w
  where w.month_start = v_month_start;

  get diagnostics v_affected = row_count;
  return v_affected;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_cs_docs_to_kaipoke_documents()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_updated_count bigint := 0;
begin
  with doc_rows as (
    select
      d.kaipoke_cs_id,
      d.id,
      d.created_at,
      d.updated_at,
      public.build_cs_document_json_from_cs_docs(
        d.id,
        d.url,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(d.doc_name), ''), '分類不能'),
        d.doc_date_raw,
        d.source,
        d.summary,
        d.doc_type_id,
        d.classification_confidence,
        d.created_at,
        d.updated_at,
        d.meta
      ) as doc_json
    from public.cs_docs d
    where d.kaipoke_cs_id is not null
  ),
  grouped as (
    select
      cki.id as cki_id,
      jsonb_agg(
        dr.doc_json
        order by
          (dr.doc_json->>'doc_date_raw') desc nulls last,
          dr.updated_at desc,
          dr.created_at desc,
          dr.id desc
      ) as new_documents
    from public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
    join doc_rows dr
      on dr.kaipoke_cs_id = cki.kaipoke_cs_id
    group by cki.id
  )
  update public.cs_kaipoke_info cki
     set documents = grouped.new_documents
    from grouped
   where cki.id = grouped.cki_id
     and coalesce(cki.documents::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)
         is distinct from
         coalesce(grouped.new_documents, '[]'::jsonb);

  get diagnostics v_updated_count = row_count;
  return v_updated_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_sender_pattern(p_office_id bigint, p_fax_number character varying, p_sender_name character varying, p_page_count integer, p_is_reversed boolean, p_rotation_data jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO cm_fax_sender_patterns (
    office_id, fax_number, sender_name,
    page_order_pattern, page_order_sample_count,
    rotation_patterns, rotation_sample_count,
    avg_page_count, total_fax_count, last_fax_received_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_office_id, 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(p_fax_number, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'),  -- 正規化して保存
    p_sender_name,
    CASE WHEN p_is_reversed THEN 'reversed' ELSE 'normal' END, 
    1,
    COALESCE(p_rotation_data, '{}'::JSONB), 
    1,
    p_page_count, 
    1, 
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (office_id, fax_number, sender_name) DO UPDATE SET
    page_order_sample_count = cm_fax_sender_patterns.page_order_sample_count + 1,
    page_order_pattern = CASE 
      WHEN p_is_reversed AND cm_fax_sender_patterns.page_order_pattern = 'normal' THEN 'mixed'
      WHEN NOT p_is_reversed AND cm_fax_sender_patterns.page_order_pattern = 'reversed' THEN 'mixed'
      ELSE cm_fax_sender_patterns.page_order_pattern
    END,
    page_order_confidence = CASE
      WHEN cm_fax_sender_patterns.page_order_sample_count >= 5 THEN 
        CASE cm_fax_sender_patterns.page_order_pattern
          WHEN 'normal' THEN 90.0
          WHEN 'reversed' THEN 90.0
          ELSE 50.0
        END
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    rotation_patterns = COALESCE(cm_fax_sender_patterns.rotation_patterns, '{}'::JSONB) || COALESCE(p_rotation_data, '{}'::JSONB),
    rotation_sample_count = cm_fax_sender_patterns.rotation_sample_count + 1,
    avg_page_count = ROUND(
      (cm_fax_sender_patterns.avg_page_count * cm_fax_sender_patterns.total_fax_count + p_page_count)::NUMERIC 
      / (cm_fax_sender_patterns.total_fax_count + 1), 2
    ),
    total_fax_count = cm_fax_sender_patterns.total_fax_count + 1,
    last_fax_received_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW();
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_text_pattern(p_pattern_text character varying, p_pattern_type character varying, p_kaipoke_cs_id character varying, p_client_name character varying)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO fax_text_patterns (
    pattern_text, pattern_type, kaipoke_cs_id, client_name, match_count, last_matched_at
  )
  VALUES (
    p_pattern_text, p_pattern_type, p_kaipoke_cs_id, p_client_name, 1, NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (pattern_text, kaipoke_cs_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    match_count = fax_text_patterns.match_count + 1,
    last_matched_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW();
  
  -- 信頼度を更新（同じテキストに対する全マッチ数で正規化）
  UPDATE fax_text_patterns fp1
  SET confidence = (fp1.match_count::DECIMAL / (
    SELECT SUM(match_count) FROM fax_text_patterns fp2 
    WHERE fp2.pattern_text = fp1.pattern_text
  )) * 100
  WHERE fp1.pattern_text = p_pattern_text;
  
END;
$function$

views.name: _table_definition
views.definition:
WITH tbl AS (
         SELECT pg_tables.schemaname,
            pg_tables.tablename
           FROM pg_tables
          WHERE pg_tables.schemaname = 'public'::name
        ), cols AS (
         SELECT t.schemaname,
            t.tablename,
            ((((('CREATE TABLE '::text || quote_ident(t.schemaname::text)) || '.'::text) || quote_ident(t.tablename::text)) || ' (
'::text) || string_agg(((((('  '::text || quote_ident(c.column_name::text)) || ' '::text) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN c.data_type::text = 'USER-DEFINED'::text THEN quote_ident(c.udt_name::text)::character varying
                    ELSE c.data_type::character varying
                END::text) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.data_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['character varying'::character varying, 'character'::character varying, 'varchar'::character varying, 'char'::character varying]::text[])) AND c.character_maximum_length IS NOT NULL THEN ('('::text || c.character_maximum_length) || ')'::text
                    WHEN (c.data_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['numeric'::character varying, 'decimal'::character varying]::text[])) AND c.numeric_precision IS NOT NULL THEN (('('::text || c.numeric_precision) || COALESCE(','::text || c.numeric_scale, ''::text)) || ')'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN c.is_nullable::text = 'NO'::text THEN ' NOT NULL'::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN c.column_default IS NOT NULL THEN ' DEFAULT '::text || c.column_default::text
                    ELSE ''::text
                END, ',
'::text ORDER BY c.ordinal_position)) || '
);
'::text AS ddl_text
           FROM tbl t
             JOIN information_schema.columns c ON c.table_schema::name = t.schemaname AND c.table_name::name = t.tablename
          GROUP BY t.schemaname, t.tablename
        ), cons AS (
         SELECT n.nspname AS schemaname,
            c.relname AS tablename,
            ((((((('ALTER TABLE '::text || quote_ident(n.nspname::text)) || '.'::text) || quote_ident(c.relname::text)) || ' ADD CONSTRAINT '::text) || quote_ident(pc.conname::text)) || ' '::text) || pg_get_constraintdef(pc.oid)) || ';\n'::text AS ddl_text
           FROM pg_constraint pc
             JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = pc.conrelid
             JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
          WHERE n.nspname = 'public'::name AND c.relkind = 'r'::"char"
        ), idx AS (
         SELECT pg_indexes.schemaname,
            pg_indexes.tablename,
            pg_indexes.indexdef || ';\n'::text AS ddl_text
           FROM pg_indexes
          WHERE pg_indexes.schemaname = 'public'::name
        )
 SELECT x.ddl_text
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS sort_group,
            cols.schemaname,
            cols.tablename,
            cols.ddl_text
           FROM cols
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 2 AS sort_group,
            cons.schemaname,
            cons.tablename,
            cons.ddl_text
           FROM cons
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 3 AS sort_group,
            idx.schemaname,
            idx.tablename,
            idx.ddl_text
           FROM idx) x
  ORDER BY x.sort_group, x.tablename, x.ddl_text;

views.name: _table_definition_full
views.definition:
SELECT c.table_name,
    c.ordinal_position,
    c.column_name,
    c.data_type,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.column_default,
    tc.constraint_type
   FROM information_schema.columns c
     LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON c.table_name::name = kcu.table_name::name AND c.column_name::name = kcu.column_name::name
     LEFT JOIN information_schema.table_constraints tc ON kcu.constraint_name::name = tc.constraint_name::name
  WHERE c.table_schema::name = 'public'::name
  ORDER BY c.table_name, c.ordinal_position;

views.name: biz_stats_defect_rate_view
views.definition:
SELECT d.snapshot_month,
    d.year_month,
    d.orgunitid,
    d.orgunitname,
    d.value AS defect_count,
    s.value AS service_hours,
        CASE
            WHEN s.value IS NULL OR s.value = 0::numeric THEN 1.0
            ELSE round(d.value / s.value, 6)
        END AS defect_rate,
    d.avg_3m AS defect_avg_3m,
    s.avg_3m AS service_avg_3m,
        CASE
            WHEN s.avg_3m IS NULL OR s.avg_3m = 0::numeric THEN 1.0
            ELSE round(d.avg_3m / s.avg_3m, 6)
        END AS defect_rate_avg_3m,
    d.displaylevel,
    d.sort_lv2_order,
    d.sort_lv3_order
   FROM biz_stats_defect_sum_display_view d
     LEFT JOIN biz_stats_shift_sum_display_view s ON s.snapshot_month = d.snapshot_month AND s.year_month = d.year_month AND s.orgunitid = d.orgunitid AND s.metric = 'team_service_hours'::text
  WHERE d.metric = 'team_lv5_defect_count'::text;

views.name: biz_stats_defect_sum_display_view
views.definition:
SELECT b.metric,
    b.snapshot_month,
    b.year_month,
    b.orgunitid,
    b.orgunitname,
    b.value,
    b.avg_3m,
    b.snapshot_at,
    b.meta,
        CASE
            WHEN b.orgunitid = 'TOTAL'::text THEN 999999
            WHEN b.orgunitid = 'UNASSIGNED'::text THEN 999998
            ELSE COALESCE(os.sort_lv2_order, 999997)
        END AS sort_lv2_order,
        CASE
            WHEN b.orgunitid = ANY (ARRAY['TOTAL'::text, 'UNASSIGNED'::text]) THEN 99
            ELSE os.displaylevel
        END AS displaylevel,

views.definition:
SELECT j.id,
    j.queue,
    j.job_type,
    j.status,
    j.payload,
    j.result,
    j.progress_message,
    j.error_message,
    j.created_at,
    j.updated_at,
    count(i.id) AS total_items,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'completed'::text) AS completed_items,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'failed'::text) AS failed_items,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'pending'::text) AS pending_items,
        CASE
            WHEN count(i.id) = 0 THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE round(count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'completed'::text)::numeric * 100.0 / count(i.id)::numeric, 1)
        END AS progress_percent
   FROM cm_jobs j
     LEFT JOIN cm_job_items i ON j.id = i.job_id
  GROUP BY j.id;

views.definition:
SELECT ci.id,
    ci.kaipoke_cs_id,
    ci.name,
    ci.end_at,
    ci.service_kind,
    ci.email,
    ci.biko,
    ci.gender_request,
    ci.postal_code,
    ci.standard_route,
    ci.commuting_flg,
    ci.standard_trans_ways,
    ci.standard_purpose,
    ci.time_adjustability_id,
    ci.documents,
    ci.time_adjustability,
    ci.is_active,
    ci.address,
    ci.kana,
    ci.gender,
    ci.phone_01,
    ci.phone_02,
    ci.birth_yyyy_mm_dd,
    ci.kaipoke_biko,
    ci.kodoengo_plan_link,
    ci.care_consultant,
    ci.ido_jukyusyasho,
    ci.asigned_org,
    ci.asigned_jisseki_staff,
    ci.pre_org_icon_id,
    ci.kaigo_hoken_no,
    ci.kaigo_start_at,
    ci.kaigo_end_at,
    ci.shogai_jukyusha_no,
    ci.shogai_start_at,
    ci.shogai_end_at,
    ci.ido_start_at,
    ci.ido_end_at,
    ci.name_kana,
    COALESCE(document_data.document_summary, ''::text) AS document_summary,
    COALESCE(document_data.document_summary, ''::text) AS shift_detail_information
   FROM cs_kaipoke_info ci
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT extracted_summary.summary_text AS document_summary
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                CASE
                    WHEN ci.documents IS NULL THEN '[]'::jsonb
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(ci.documents) = 'array'::text THEN ci.documents
                    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
                END) document_item(value)
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM
                        CASE
                            WHEN POSITION(('【4】'::text) IN (COALESCE(document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text, ''::text))) > 0 THEN regexp_replace(SUBSTRING(document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text FROM POSITION(('【4】'::text) IN (document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text))), '(【6】|【7】|【文書分類).*'::text, ''::text, 's'::text)
                            WHEN POSITION(('【5】'::text) IN (COALESCE(document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text, ''::text))) > 0 THEN regexp_replace(SUBSTRING(document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text FROM POSITION(('【5】'::text) IN (document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text))), '(【6】|【7】|【文書分類).*'::text, ''::text, 's'::text)
                            ELSE NULL::text
                        END), ''::text) AS summary_text) extracted_summary
          WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM document_item.value ->> 'label'::text) = '基本情報(ステップ２）'::text AND NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM document_item.value ->> 'summary'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND extracted_summary.summary_text IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY (
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(document_item.value ->> 'updated_at'::text, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN (document_item.value ->> 'updated_at'::text)::timestamp with time zone
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) DESC NULLS LAST, (
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(document_item.value ->> 'created_at'::text, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN (document_item.value ->> 'created_at'::text)::timestamp with time zone
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) document_data ON true;

views.name: dashboard_service_time_qualification_breakdown_view
views.definition:
WITH category_totals AS (
         SELECT dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.year_month,
            dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.service_category,
            sum(dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.total_hours) AS total_service_hours,
            sum(dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.total_hours) FILTER (WHERE dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.qualified) AS qualified_service_hours,
                CASE dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.service_category
                    WHEN '障害福祉（家事・身体・通院等介助）'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN '行動援護'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN '同行援護'::text THEN 3
                    WHEN '重度訪問'::text THEN 4
                    WHEN '移動支援'::text THEN 5
                    WHEN '訪問介護（要介護）'::text THEN 6
                    WHEN '訪問介護（要支援）'::text THEN 7
                    WHEN '自費'::text THEN 8
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END AS category_order
           FROM dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows() dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows(year_month, service_date, service_category, total_hours, staff_user_id, qualified)
          WHERE dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.year_month <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE + '1 mon'::interval, 'YYYY-MM'::text)
          GROUP BY dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.year_month, dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.service_category
        ), rows_with_total AS (
         SELECT category_totals.year_month,
            category_totals.service_category,
            category_totals.total_service_hours,
            category_totals.qualified_service_hours,
            category_totals.category_order
           FROM category_totals
        UNION ALL
         SELECT category_totals.year_month,
            '合計'::text,
            sum(category_totals.total_service_hours) AS sum,
            sum(category_totals.qualified_service_hours) AS sum,
            9
           FROM category_totals
          GROUP BY category_totals.year_month
        )
 SELECT rows_with_total.year_month,
    rows_with_total.service_category,
    round(rows_with_total.total_service_hours, 2) AS total_service_hours,
    round(COALESCE(rows_with_total.qualified_service_hours, 0::numeric), 2) AS qualified_service_hours,
    round(100::numeric * COALESCE(rows_with_total.qualified_service_hours, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(rows_with_total.total_service_hours, 0::numeric), 1) AS qualified_ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN (100::numeric * COALESCE(rows_with_total.qualified_service_hours, 0::numeric) / NULLIF(rows_with_total.total_service_hours, 0::numeric)) >= 50::numeric THEN '基準クリア'::text
            ELSE '要確認'::text
        END AS threshold_status,
    rows_with_total.category_order
   FROM rows_with_total;

views.name: dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_detail_view
views.definition:
WITH staff_hours AS (
         SELECT dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.year_month,
            dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.service_category,
            dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.staff_user_id,
            sum(dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.total_hours) AS total_service_hours,
            COALESCE(sum(dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.total_hours) FILTER (WHERE dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.qualified), 0::numeric) AS qualified_service_hours
           FROM dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows() dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows(year_month, service_date, service_category, total_hours, staff_user_id, qualified)
          WHERE dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.year_month <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE + '1 mon'::interval, 'YYYY-MM'::text)
          GROUP BY dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.year_month, dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.service_category, dashboard_service_time_qualification_staff_rows.staff_user_id
        ), qualification_rows AS (
         SELECT fe.auth_uid,
            attachment.value ->> 'label'::text AS qualification_name,
            acquired.acquired_date
           FROM form_entries fe
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(fe.attachments, '[]'::jsonb)) attachment(value)
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at'::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])'::text THEN to_date("left"(attachment.value ->> 'acquired_at'::text, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)
                            ELSE NULL::date
                        END AS acquired_date) acquired
             JOIN user_doc_master qm ON qm.category = 'certificate'::text AND qm.is_active = true AND qm.label = (attachment.value ->> 'label'::text) AND (qm.label = ANY (ARRAY['介護福祉士'::text, '実務者研修修了'::text]))
          WHERE fe.auth_uid IS NOT NULL AND ((attachment.value ->> 'type'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['資格証明書'::text, 'certificate'::text, 'certification'::text]))
        ), qualification_info AS (
         SELECT qualification_rows.auth_uid,
            string_agg(((qualification_rows.qualification_name || '（'::text) || COALESCE(to_char(qualification_rows.acquired_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text), '取得日未設定'::text)) || '）'::text, ' / '::text ORDER BY qualification_rows.acquired_date, qualification_rows.qualification_name) AS qualifications,
            min(qualification_rows.acquired_date) AS qualification_from
           FROM qualification_rows
          GROUP BY qualification_rows.auth_uid
        )
 SELECT sh.year_month,
    sh.service_category,
    sh.staff_user_id,
    concat_ws(''::text, u.last_name_kanji, u.first_name_kanji) AS staff_name,
    COALESCE(qi.qualifications, '対象資格なし'::text) AS qualifications,
    qi.qualification_from,
    round(sh.total_service_hours, 2) AS total_service_hours,
    round(sh.qualified_service_hours, 2) AS qualified_service_hours,
    round(100::numeric * sh.qualified_service_hours / NULLIF(sh.total_service_hours, 0::numeric), 1) AS qualified_ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN sh.qualified_service_hours > 0::numeric THEN '資格者時間あり'::text
            ELSE '対象外'::text
        END AS qualification_status
   FROM staff_hours sh
     JOIN user_entry_united_view_single u ON u.user_id = sh.staff_user_id
     LEFT JOIN qualification_info qi ON qi.auth_uid = u.auth_uid;

views.name: dashboard_staff_monthly_service_hours_view
views.definition:
WITH participating_staff AS (
         SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone), 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS year_month,
            participant.staff_user_id,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM upper(s.shift_timerange) - lower(s.shift_timerange)) / 3600.0 AS service_hours
           FROM shift s
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id,true), (s.staff_02_user_id,NOT COALESCE(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false)), (s.staff_03_user_id,NOT COALESCE(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false))) participant(staff_user_id, is_service_staff)
          WHERE s.shift_start_date >= '2025-11-01'::date AND s.shift_start_time IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.kaipoke_cs_id !~~ '99999999%'::text AND (s.service_code IS NULL OR s.service_code !~~* '%キャンセル%'::text) AND participant.is_service_staff AND NULLIF(participant.staff_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL
        ), staff_hours AS (
         SELECT participating_staff.year_month,
            participating_staff.staff_user_id,
            round(sum(participating_staff.service_hours), 2) AS total_service_hours
           FROM participating_staff
          GROUP BY participating_staff.year_month, participating_staff.staff_user_id
        )
 SELECT staff_hours.year_month,
    staff_hours.staff_user_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(''::text, staff.last_name_kanji, staff.first_name_kanji), ''::text), staff_hours.staff_user_id) AS staff_name,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(users.role, ''::text), users.system_role) = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'manager'::text]) THEN 'マネジャー'::text
            ELSE 'スタッフ'::text
        END AS manager_category,
    staff_hours.total_service_hours
   FROM staff_hours
     LEFT JOIN user_entry_united_view_single staff ON staff.user_id = staff_hours.staff_user_id
     LEFT JOIN users users ON users.user_id = staff_hours.staff_user_id;

views.name: disability_check_view
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            to_char(s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS year_month,
            ssc.kaipoke_servicek,
            max(cki.name) AS client_name,
            max(cki.ido_jukyusyasho) AS ido_jukyusyasho,
            bool_and(COALESCE(dc.is_checked, false)) AS is_checked,
            max(pd.district) AS district,
            max(COALESCE(dc.asigned_jisseki_staff, cki.asigned_jisseki_staff)) AS asigned_jisseki_staff_id,
            bool_and(COALESCE(dc.application_check, false)) AS application_check
           FROM shift s
             JOIN shift_service_code ssc ON s.service_code = ssc.service_code
             JOIN cs_kaipoke_info cki ON s.kaipoke_cs_id = cki.kaipoke_cs_id
             LEFT JOIN disability_check dc ON dc.kaipoke_cs_id = s.kaipoke_cs_id AND dc.year_month = to_char(s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AND dc.kaipoke_servicek = ssc.kaipoke_servicek
             LEFT JOIN postal_district pd ON SUBSTRING(cki.postal_code FROM 1 FOR 3) = pd.postal_code_3
          WHERE ssc.kaipoke_servicek = ANY (ARRAY['障害'::text, '移動支援'::text])
          GROUP BY s.kaipoke_cs_id, (to_char(s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text)), ssc.kaipoke_servicek
        ), staff_org AS (
         SELECT u_1.user_id,
            COALESCE(ex.orgunitid::text, u_1.org_unit_id) AS asigned_org_id
           FROM user_entry_united_view_single u_1
             LEFT JOIN user_org_exception ex ON ex.user_id = u_1.user_id
        )
 SELECT b.kaipoke_cs_id,
    b.year_month,
    b.kaipoke_servicek,
    b.client_name,
    b.ido_jukyusyasho,
    b.is_checked,
    b.district,
    b.asigned_jisseki_staff_id,
    u.last_name_kanji || u.first_name_kanji AS asigned_jisseki_staff_name,
    so.asigned_org_id,
    o.orgunitname AS asigned_org_name,
    b.application_check
   FROM base b
     LEFT JOIN user_entry_united_view_single u ON u.user_id = b.asigned_jisseki_staff_id
     LEFT JOIN staff_org so ON so.user_id = b.asigned_jisseki_staff_id
     LEFT JOIN orgs o ON o.orgunitid = so.asigned_org_id;

views.name: manager_monthly_distance_index_view
views.definition:
WITH params AS (
         SELECT (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) - '3 mons'::interval)::date AS start_date,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon'::interval)::date AS end_date
        ), staff_master AS (
         SELECT u.user_id,
            concat_ws(' '::text, u.last_name_kanji, u.first_name_kanji) AS staff_name,
            NULLIF("left"(regexp_replace(COALESCE(u.postal_code, ''::text), '[^0-9]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 3), ''::text)::integer AS home_postal_prefix
           FROM user_entry_united_view_single u
          WHERE u.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (u.system_role = ANY (ARRAY['manager'::text, 'admin'::text]))
        ), target_shifts AS (
         SELECT s.shift_id,
            sm.user_id,
            sm.staff_name,
            sm.home_postal_prefix,
            s.shift_start_date AS work_date,
            s.shift_start_time AS start_time,
            NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.postal_code_3, ''::text), '[^0-9]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), ''::text)::integer AS customer_postal_prefix
           FROM shift_csinfo_postalname_view2 s
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id), (s.staff_02_user_id), (s.staff_03_user_id)) assigned_staff(user_id)
             JOIN staff_master sm ON sm.user_id = assigned_staff.user_id
             CROSS JOIN params p
          WHERE s.shift_start_date >= p.start_date AND s.shift_start_date < p.end_date AND assigned_staff.user_id IS NOT NULL AND assigned_staff.user_id <> ''::text AND sm.home_postal_prefix IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.postal_code_3, ''::text), '[^0-9]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL
        ), ordered_shifts AS (
         SELECT ts.shift_id,
            ts.user_id,
            ts.staff_name,
            ts.home_postal_prefix,
            ts.work_date,
            ts.start_time,
            ts.customer_postal_prefix,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ts.user_id, ts.work_date ORDER BY ts.start_time, ts.shift_id) AS visit_no,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ts.user_id, ts.work_date) AS visit_count
           FROM target_shifts ts
        ), movement_points AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT os.user_id,
            os.staff_name,
            os.work_date,
            0::bigint AS point_order,
            os.home_postal_prefix AS postal_prefix
           FROM ordered_shifts os
        UNION ALL
         SELECT os.user_id,
            os.staff_name,
            os.work_date,
            os.visit_no AS point_order,
            os.customer_postal_prefix AS postal_prefix
           FROM ordered_shifts os
        UNION ALL
         SELECT DISTINCT os.user_id,
            os.staff_name,
            os.work_date,
            os.visit_count + 1 AS point_order,
            os.home_postal_prefix AS postal_prefix
           FROM ordered_shifts os
        ), movement_with_previous AS (
         SELECT mp.user_id,
            mp.staff_name,
            mp.work_date,
            mp.point_order,
            mp.postal_prefix,
            lag(mp.postal_prefix) OVER (PARTITION BY mp.user_id, mp.work_date ORDER BY mp.point_order) AS previous_postal_prefix
           FROM movement_points mp
        ), movement_segments AS (
         SELECT mwp.user_id,
            mwp.staff_name,
            mwp.work_date,
            abs(mwp.postal_prefix - mwp.previous_postal_prefix) AS distance_index
           FROM movement_with_previous mwp
          WHERE mwp.previous_postal_prefix IS NOT NULL
        ), monthly_summary AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, ms.work_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS target_month,
            ms.user_id,
            ms.staff_name,
            count(DISTINCT ms.work_date)::integer AS work_day_count,
            count(*)::integer AS movement_segment_count,
            COALESCE(sum(ms.distance_index), 0::bigint) AS monthly_distance_index
           FROM movement_segments ms
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, ms.work_date::timestamp with time zone)::date), ms.user_id, ms.staff_name
        )
 SELECT monthly_summary.target_month,
    monthly_summary.user_id,
    monthly_summary.staff_name,
    monthly_summary.work_day_count,
    monthly_summary.movement_segment_count,
    monthly_summary.monthly_distance_index
   FROM monthly_summary;

views.name: manager_monthly_google_maps_distance_view
views.definition:
WITH months AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, CURRENT_DATE - ((series.n || ' months'::text)::interval))::date AS target_month
           FROM generate_series('-3'::integer, 12) series(n)
        ), managers AS (
         SELECT u.user_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' '::text, fe.last_name_kanji, fe.first_name_kanji), ''::text), u.user_id) AS staff_name
           FROM users u
             LEFT JOIN form_entries fe ON fe.id = u.entry_id
          WHERE (lower(COALESCE(u.system_role, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['manager'::text, 'admin'::text, 'system_admin'::text, 'super_admin'::text])) AND (concat_ws(' '::text, fe.last_name_kanji, fe.first_name_kanji) <> ALL (ARRAY['濵川 千咲'::text, 'サービス サポート'::text, '益田 名実'::text, '塩澤 里美'::text, '高橋 りか'::text, '松岡 佑太'::text, '増田 志乃'::text, '太田 明子'::text, '大津 美羽'::text, '池本 梨夏'::text, '長谷川 愛'::text, '渡久地 泰子'::text, '白井 伶佳'::text, '小針 京子'::text]))
        )
 SELECT m.target_month,
    mgr.user_id,
    mgr.staff_name,
    count(DISTINCT s.segment_date)::integer AS work_day_count,
    count(s.id)::integer AS movement_segment_count,
    round(COALESCE(sum(s.distance_meters), 0::bigint)::numeric / 1000::numeric, 1) AS monthly_distance_index,
    max(s.calculated_at) AS last_updated_at
   FROM managers mgr
     CROSS JOIN months m
     LEFT JOIN manager_distance_segments s ON s.staff_user_id = mgr.user_id AND date_trunc('month'::text, s.segment_date::timestamp with time zone)::date = m.target_month AND s.status = 'success'::text AND s.distance_meters IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.target_month, mgr.user_id, mgr.staff_name;

views.name: orgs_sort
views.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE climb AS (
         SELECT o_1.orgunitid AS child_id,
            o_1.orgunitname AS child_name,
            o_1.displaylevel AS child_level,
            o_1.displayorder AS child_order,
            o_1.parentorgunitid AS parent_id,
            o_1.orgunitid AS cur_id,
            o_1.orgunitname AS cur_name,
            o_1.displaylevel AS cur_level,
            o_1.displayorder AS cur_order,
            o_1.parentorgunitid AS cur_parent_id
           FROM orgs o_1
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.child_id,
            c.child_name,
            c.child_level,
            c.child_order,
            c.parent_id,
            p.orgunitid AS cur_id,
            p.orgunitname AS cur_name,
            p.displaylevel AS cur_level,
            p.displayorder AS cur_order,
            p.parentorgunitid AS cur_parent_id
           FROM climb c
             JOIN orgs p ON p.orgunitid = c.cur_parent_id
          WHERE c.cur_level <> 2
        ), nearest_lv2 AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (climb.child_id) climb.child_id,
            climb.child_name,
            climb.child_level,
            climb.child_order,
            climb.parent_id,
            climb.cur_id AS lv2_id,
            climb.cur_name AS lv2_name,
            climb.cur_order AS lv2_order
           FROM climb
          WHERE climb.cur_level = 2
          ORDER BY climb.child_id
        )
 SELECT o.orgunitid,
    o.orgunitname,
    o.description,
    o.parentorgunitid,
    o.displayorder,
    o.displaylevel,
    n.lv2_id,
    n.lv2_name,
    n.lv2_order,
    COALESCE(n.lv2_order, o.displayorder, 9999) AS sort_lv2_order,
        CASE
            WHEN o.displaylevel = 3 THEN o.displayorder
            ELSE 0
        END AS sort_lv3_order
   FROM orgs o
     LEFT JOIN nearest_lv2 n ON n.child_id = o.orgunitid;

views.name: shift_daily_dialog_view
views.definition:
WITH required_actual_months AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT history.kaipoke_cs_id,
            to_char(history.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS year_month,
            history_service.kaipoke_servicek
           FROM shift history
             JOIN shift_service_code history_service ON history.service_code = history_service.service_code
          WHERE (history_service.kaipoke_servicek = ANY (ARRAY['障害'::text, '移動支援'::text])) AND history.shift_start_date >= '2025-11-01'::date AND history.shift_start_date < (date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo'::text)) -
                CASE
                    WHEN EXTRACT(day FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo'::text)) <= 10::numeric THEN '2 mons'::interval
                    ELSE '1 mon'::interval
                END + '1 mon'::interval)::date
          GROUP BY history.kaipoke_cs_id, (to_char(history.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM'::text)), history_service.kaipoke_servicek
        ), unsubmitted_actual AS (
         SELECT required.kaipoke_cs_id,
            array_agg(DISTINCT required.year_month ORDER BY required.year_month) AS months
           FROM required_actual_months required
             LEFT JOIN disability_check actual_check ON actual_check.kaipoke_cs_id = required.kaipoke_cs_id AND actual_check.year_month = required.year_month AND actual_check.kaipoke_servicek = required.kaipoke_servicek
          WHERE COALESCE(actual_check.application_check, false) = false
          GROUP BY required.kaipoke_cs_id
        ), active_event_alert_tasks AS (
         SELECT task.id,
            task.template_id,
            template.template_name AS event_name,
            task.memo,
            task.user_id,
            task.kaipoke_cs_id,
            task.due_date,
            task.created_at
           FROM event_tasks task
             JOIN event_template template ON template.id = task.template_id AND template.shift_alert = true
          WHERE task.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_progress'::text])
        ), base AS (
         SELECT s.shift_id,
            s.shift_start_date AS shift_date,
            s.shift_start_time::text AS start_at,
            s.shift_end_time::text AS end_at,
            s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            k.name AS client_name,
            k.postal_code,
            k.address,
            k.biko AS cs_note,
            k.gender_request,
            g.gender_request_name,
            g.male_flg,
            g.female_flg,
            s.service_code,
            sc.kaipoke_servicecode AS service_name,
            s.staff_01_user_id AS staff_id_1,
            s.staff_02_user_id AS staff_id_2,
            s.staff_03_user_id AS staff_id_3,
            s.staff_02_attend_flg,
            s.staff_03_attend_flg,
            s.required_staff_count,
            s.two_person_work_flg,
            s.judo_ido,
            d.dsp_short,
            'https://www.google.com/maps/search/'::text || COALESCE(k.address, k.postal_code, ''::text) AS map_url,
            COALESCE(s.shift_end_time IS NOT NULL AND (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo'::text) > (COALESCE(s.shift_end_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN s.shift_end_time < s.shift_start_time THEN s.shift_start_date + 1
                    ELSE s.shift_start_date
                END)::timestamp without time zone + s.shift_end_time::interval) AND (lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(sr.status, ''::text))) <> ALL (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'approved'::text])), false) AS roster_error_visit_record,
            COALESCE(cardinality(actual.months), 0) > 0 AS roster_error_actual_record,
            COALESCE(actual.months, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS roster_error_actual_record_months,
            COALESCE((k.service_kind = ANY (ARRAY['要介護'::text, '要支援'::text, '障害'::text])) AND COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM k.care_consultant::text), ''::text) = ''::text, false) AS roster_error_care_consultant,
            COALESCE(sc.idou_f = true AND (COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM k.standard_route), ''::text) = ''::text OR COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM k.standard_trans_ways), ''::text) = ''::text OR COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM k.standard_purpose), ''::text) = ''::text), false) AS roster_error_transport_info,
            COALESCE(s.service_code = '行動援護'::text AND COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM k.kodoengo_plan_link), ''::text) = ''::text, false) AS roster_error_kodoengo_plan
           FROM shift s
             LEFT JOIN cs_kaipoke_info k ON s.kaipoke_cs_id = k.kaipoke_cs_id
             LEFT JOIN cs_gender_request g ON k.gender_request = g.gender_request_id
             LEFT JOIN postal_district d ON "left"(k.postal_code, 3) = d.postal_code_3
             LEFT JOIN shift_service_code sc ON s.service_code = sc.service_code
             LEFT JOIN shift_records sr ON s.shift_id = sr.shift_id
             LEFT JOIN unsubmitted_actual actual ON s.kaipoke_cs_id = actual.kaipoke_cs_id
        )
 SELECT base.shift_id,
    base.shift_date,
    base.start_at,
    base.end_at,
    base.kaipoke_cs_id,
    base.client_name,
    base.postal_code,
    base.address,
    base.cs_note,
    base.gender_request,
    base.gender_request_name,
    base.male_flg,
    base.female_flg,
    base.service_code,
    base.service_name,
    base.staff_id_1,
    base.staff_id_2,
    base.staff_id_3,
    base.staff_02_attend_flg,
    base.staff_03_attend_flg,
    base.required_staff_count,
    base.two_person_work_flg,
    base.judo_ido,
    base.dsp_short,
    base.map_url,
    base.roster_error_visit_record,
    base.roster_error_actual_record,
    base.roster_error_actual_record_months,
    base.roster_error_care_consultant,
    base.roster_error_transport_info,
    base.roster_error_kodoengo_plan,
    base.roster_error_visit_record OR base.roster_error_actual_record OR base.roster_error_care_consultant OR base.roster_error_transport_info OR base.roster_error_kodoengo_plan AS has_roster_error,
    COALESCE(event_alert.alerts, '[]'::jsonb) AS shift_event_alerts
   FROM base
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', task.id, 'template_id', task.template_id, 'event_name', task.event_name, 'memo', task.memo, 'user_id', task.user_id, 'kaipoke_cs_id', task.kaipoke_cs_id, 'due_date', task.due_date) ORDER BY task.due_date, task.event_name, task.created_at, task.id) AS alerts
           FROM active_event_alert_tasks task
          WHERE task.kaipoke_cs_id = base.kaipoke_cs_id AND task.due_date <= base.shift_date) event_alert ON true;
