views.name: shift_mfcloud_payroll_monthly
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date AS target_month,
            s.shift_id,
            s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            s.service_code,
            s.judo_ido,
            s2.summary_flg AS ssc_summary_flg,
            make_timestamp(EXTRACT(year FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(month FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(hour FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer, EXTRACT(minute FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer, EXTRACT(second FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer::double precision) AS start_ts,
            make_timestamp(EXTRACT(year FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(month FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(hour FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer, EXTRACT(minute FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer, EXTRACT(second FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer::double precision) AS end_ts,
            u.user_id
           FROM ( SELECT s1.shift_id,
                    s1.kaipoke_cs_id,
                    s1.shift_start_date,
                    s1.shift_start_time,
                    s1.service_code,
                    s1.staff_01_user_id,
                    s1.staff_02_user_id,
                    s1.staff_02_attend_flg,
                    s1.staff_03_user_id,
                    s1.staff_03_attend_flg,
                    s1.update_at,
                    s1.created_at,
                    s1.shift_end_date,
                    s1.shift_end_time,
                    s1.head_shift_id,
                    s1.required_staff_count,
                    s1.two_person_work_flg,
                    s1.staff_01_role_code,
                    s1.staff_02_role_code,
                    s1.staff_03_role_code,
                    s1.judo_ido,
                    s1.tokutei_comment,
                    s1.shift_timerange,
                    s1.status,
                    s1.cancel_value,
                    s1.kaipoke_servicecode,
                    s1.kaipoke_servicek,
                    s1.summary_flg,
                    sc.summary_flg
                   FROM shift_add_status_view s1
                     LEFT JOIN shift_service_code sc ON sc.service_code = s1.service_code) s(shift_id, kaipoke_cs_id, shift_start_date, shift_start_time, service_code, staff_01_user_id, staff_02_user_id, staff_02_attend_flg, staff_03_user_id, staff_03_attend_flg, update_at, created_at, shift_end_date, shift_end_time, head_shift_id, required_staff_count, two_person_work_flg, staff_01_role_code, staff_02_role_code, staff_03_role_code, judo_ido, tokutei_comment, shift_timerange, status, cancel_value, kaipoke_servicecode, kaipoke_servicek, summary_flg, summary_flg_1)
             LEFT JOIN shift_service_code s2 ON s2.service_code = s.service_code
             JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id), (s.staff_02_user_id), (s.staff_03_user_id)) u(user_id) ON u.user_id IS NOT NULL
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_end_date IS NOT NULL
        ), per_day AS (
         SELECT b.target_month,
            b.shift_id,
            b.kaipoke_cs_id,
            b.service_code,
            b.judo_ido,
            b.ssc_summary_flg,
            b.start_ts,
            b.end_ts,
            b.user_id,
            d.d::date AS work_date,
            GREATEST(b.start_ts, d.d) AS seg_start,
            LEAST(b.end_ts, d.d + '1 day'::interval) AS seg_end
           FROM base b
             JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('day'::text, b.start_ts), date_trunc('day'::text, b.end_ts - '00:00:01'::interval), '1 day'::interval) d(d) ON b.end_ts > b.start_ts
        ), segmented AS (
         SELECT p.target_month,
            p.user_id AS "従業員番号",
            p.work_date,
            p.service_code,
            p.judo_ido,
            p.ssc_summary_flg,
            p.seg_start,
            p.seg_end,
            p.kaipoke_cs_id,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM p.seg_end - p.seg_start))::bigint AS total_sec,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(p.seg_end, date_trunc('day'::text, p.work_date::timestamp without time zone) + '19:00:00'::interval) - GREATEST(p.seg_start, date_trunc('day'::text, p.work_date::timestamp without time zone) + '08:00:00'::interval)))::bigint AS std_sec,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM p.seg_end - p.seg_start))::bigint - GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(p.seg_end, date_trunc('day'::text, p.work_date::timestamp without time zone) + '19:00:00'::interval) - GREATEST(p.seg_start, date_trunc('day'::text, p.work_date::timestamp without time zone) + '08:00:00'::interval)))::bigint AS night_sec,
            p.service_code ~ 'キャンセル'::text AS is_cancel
           FROM per_day p
        ), svc_groups AS (
         SELECT m.target_month,
            m."従業員番号",
            m.work_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN m.lag_end IS NULL THEN 1
                    WHEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM m.seg_start - m.lag_end) = 0::numeric THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END AS start_flag
           FROM ( SELECT b.target_month,
                    b."従業員番号",
                    b.work_date,
                    b.seg_start,
                    b.seg_end,
                    lag(b.seg_end) OVER (PARTITION BY b.target_month, b."従業員番号", b.work_date ORDER BY b.seg_start, b.seg_end) AS lag_end
                   FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT m_1.target_month,
                            m_1."従業員番号",
                            m_1.work_date,
                            m_1.seg_start,
                            m_1.seg_end
                           FROM segmented m_1
                          WHERE m_1.total_sec > 0 AND m_1.is_cancel = false AND m_1.kaipoke_cs_id <> '9999999980'::text) b) m
        ), svc_month AS (
         SELECT svc_groups.target_month,
            svc_groups."従業員番号",
            sum(svc_groups.start_flag) AS svc_cnt
           FROM svc_groups
          GROUP BY svc_groups.target_month, svc_groups."従業員番号"
        ), weighted AS (
         SELECT m.target_month,
            m."従業員番号",
            m.work_date,
            m.service_code,
            m.judo_ido,
            m.ssc_summary_flg,
            m.seg_start,
            m.seg_end,
            m.kaipoke_cs_id,
            m.total_sec,
            m.std_sec,
            m.night_sec,
            m.is_cancel,
            NULLIF(regexp_replace(m.ssc_summary_flg, '.*?(身体|同行|行動)\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*.*'::text, '\2'::text), m.ssc_summary_flg)::numeric AS coeff_raw
           FROM segmented m
        ), weighted_fix AS (
         SELECT w.target_month,
            w."従業員番号",
            w.work_date,
            w.service_code,
            w.judo_ido,
            w.ssc_summary_flg,
            w.seg_start,
            w.seg_end,
            w.kaipoke_cs_id,
            w.total_sec,
            w.std_sec,
            w.night_sec,
            w.is_cancel,
            w.coeff_raw,
                CASE
                    WHEN w.ssc_summary_flg ~ '(身体|同行|行動)'::text THEN COALESCE(w.coeff_raw, 1.0)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS coeff
           FROM weighted w
        ), secs_month AS (
         SELECT m.target_month,
            m."従業員番号",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.is_cancel = false THEN m.std_sec
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END)::bigint AS std_sec_sum,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.is_cancel = false THEN m.night_sec
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END)::bigint AS night_sec_sum
           FROM segmented m
          GROUP BY m.target_month, m."従業員番号"
        ), weighted_secs_month AS (
         SELECT wf.target_month,
            wf."従業員番号",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN wf.is_cancel = false AND wf.coeff IS NOT NULL THEN (wf.std_sec + wf.night_sec)::numeric * wf.coeff
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) AS w_secs
           FROM weighted_fix wf
          GROUP BY wf.target_month, wf."従業員番号"
        ), heavy_move_month AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date AS target_month,
            u.user_id AS "従業員番号",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.service_code ~ 'キャンセル'::text THEN 0
                    ELSE
                    CASE
                        WHEN length(regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.judo_ido, ''::text), '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)) >= 1 THEN SUBSTRING(lpad(regexp_replace(s.judo_ido, '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 4, '0'::text) FROM 1 FOR 2)::integer * 3600 + SUBSTRING(lpad(regexp_replace(s.judo_ido, '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 4, '0'::text) FROM 3 FOR 2)::integer * 60
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                END) AS hm_secs
           FROM shift_add_status_view s
             JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id), (s.staff_02_user_id), (s.staff_03_user_id)) u(user_id) ON u.user_id IS NOT NULL
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date), u.user_id
        ), days_month AS (
         SELECT m.target_month,
            m."従業員番号",
            count(DISTINCT m.work_date) AS days_cnt
           FROM segmented m
          WHERE m.is_cancel = false AND m.total_sec > 0 AND m.kaipoke_cs_id <> '9999999980'::text
          GROUP BY m.target_month, m."従業員番号"
        ), ido_month AS (
         SELECT m.target_month,
            m."従業員番号",
            count(*)::numeric AS move_cnt
           FROM segmented m
          WHERE m.service_code ~~ '%（片道支援）%'::text AND m.is_cancel = false
          GROUP BY m.target_month, m."従業員番号"
        ), cancel_month AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date AS target_month,
            u.user_id AS "従業員番号",
            count(DISTINCT s.shift_id) AS cancel_cnt
           FROM shift_add_status_view s
             JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id), (s.staff_02_user_id), (s.staff_03_user_id)) u(user_id) ON u.user_id IS NOT NULL
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.service_code ~ 'キャンセル'::text
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date), u.user_id
        ), unit_sec AS (
         SELECT u.user_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN "right"(translate(TRIM(BOTH FROM u.roster_sort), '０１２３４５６７８９'::text, '0123456789'::text), 1) = '1'::text THEN 600
                    ELSE 900
                END AS add_unit_sec
           FROM users u
        ), keys AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT segmented.target_month,
            segmented."従業員番号"
           FROM segmented
        UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT cancel_month.target_month,
            cancel_month."従業員番号"
           FROM cancel_month
        UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT ido_month.target_month,
            ido_month."従業員番号"
           FROM ido_month
        UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT days_month.target_month,
            days_month."従業員番号"
           FROM days_month
        UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT heavy_move_month.target_month,
            heavy_move_month."従業員番号"
           FROM heavy_move_month
        )
 SELECT 3 AS "Version",
    ''::text AS "従業員識別子",
    k."従業員番号",
    ''::text AS "姓",
    ''::text AS "名",
    ''::text AS "事業所名",
    ''::text AS "部門名",
    ''::text AS "職種名",
    ''::text AS "契約種別",
    COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) AS "出勤日数（平日）",
    (lpad(((COALESCE(sm.std_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + GREATEST(COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) * COALESCE(au.add_unit_sec, 900) +
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 900
            ELSE 0
        END) / 3600)::text, 3, '0'::text) || ':'::text) || lpad(((COALESCE(sm.std_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + GREATEST(COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) * COALESCE(au.add_unit_sec, 900) +
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 900
            ELSE 0
        END) / 60 % 60::bigint)::text, 2, '0'::text) AS "所定時間（平日）",
    (lpad((COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) / 3600)::text, 3, '0'::text) || ':'::text) || lpad((COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) / 60 % 60::bigint)::text, 2, '0'::text) AS "深夜所定時間（平日）",
    ''::text AS "有休取得日数",
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(sm.std_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + GREATEST(COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) * COALESCE(au.add_unit_sec, 900) +
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 900
                ELSE 0
            END) <= 0 THEN '0'::text
            ELSE ceil((COALESCE(sm.std_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + GREATEST(COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) * COALESCE(au.add_unit_sec, 900) +
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 900
                ELSE 0
            END)::numeric / 3600.0)::text
        END AS "処遇改善加算",
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(sm.std_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + GREATEST(COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) * COALESCE(au.add_unit_sec, 900) +
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 900
                ELSE 0
            END) <= 0 THEN '0'::text
            ELSE ceil((COALESCE(sm.std_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(sm.night_sec_sum, 0::bigint) + GREATEST(COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint), 0::bigint) * COALESCE(au.add_unit_sec, 900) +
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(dm.days_cnt, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 900
                ELSE 0
            END)::numeric / 3600.0)::text
        END AS "特定処遇改善加算",
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(wm.w_secs, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN '0'::text
            ELSE ceil(COALESCE(wm.w_secs, 0::numeric) / 3600.0)::text
        END AS "身体・同行・行動時間",
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(hm.hm_secs, 0::bigint) <= 0 THEN '0'::text
            ELSE ceil(COALESCE(hm.hm_secs, 0::bigint)::numeric / 3600.0)::text
        END AS "重訪移動時間",
    COALESCE(im.move_cnt, 0::numeric) AS "移動回数",
    ''::text AS "独自回数",
    ''::text AS "食事回数",
    COALESCE(cm.cancel_cnt, 0::bigint) AS "キャンセル回数",
    ''::text AS "年末年始出勤時間",
    COALESCE(sm2.svc_cnt, 0::bigint) AS "サービス回数",
    k.target_month
   FROM keys k
     LEFT JOIN secs_month sm ON sm.target_month = k.target_month AND sm."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN weighted_secs_month wm ON wm.target_month = k.target_month AND wm."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN heavy_move_month hm ON hm.target_month = k.target_month AND hm."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN days_month dm ON dm.target_month = k.target_month AND dm."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN ido_month im ON im.target_month = k.target_month AND im."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN svc_month sm2 ON sm2.target_month = k.target_month AND sm2."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN cancel_month cm ON cm.target_month = k.target_month AND cm."従業員番号" = k."従業員番号"
     LEFT JOIN unit_sec au ON au.user_id = k."従業員番号"
  ORDER BY k.target_month, k."従業員番号";

views.name: shift_mfcloud_payroll_monthly_plus_tsuin
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date AS target_month,
            s.shift_id,
            s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            s.service_code,
            sc.summary_flg AS ssc_summary_flg,
            make_timestamp(EXTRACT(year FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(month FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(hour FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer, EXTRACT(minute FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer, EXTRACT(second FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer::double precision) AS start_ts,
            make_timestamp(EXTRACT(year FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(month FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(hour FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer, EXTRACT(minute FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer, EXTRACT(second FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer::double precision) AS end_ts,
            u.user_id AS "従業員番号"
           FROM shift_add_status_view s
             LEFT JOIN shift_service_code sc ON sc.service_code = s.service_code
             JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id), (s.staff_02_user_id), (s.staff_03_user_id)) u(user_id) ON u.user_id IS NOT NULL
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_end_date IS NOT NULL
        ), per_day AS (
         SELECT b.target_month,
            b."従業員番号",
            b.shift_id,
            b.kaipoke_cs_id,
            b.service_code,
            b.ssc_summary_flg,
            d.d::date AS work_date,
            GREATEST(b.start_ts, d.d) AS seg_start,
            LEAST(b.end_ts, d.d + '1 day'::interval) AS seg_end
           FROM base b
             JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('day'::text, b.start_ts), date_trunc('day'::text, b.end_ts - '00:00:01'::interval), '1 day'::interval) d(d) ON b.end_ts > b.start_ts
        ), segmented AS (
         SELECT p.target_month,
            p."従業員番号",
            p.shift_id,
            p.kaipoke_cs_id,
            p.service_code,
            p.ssc_summary_flg,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM p.seg_end - p.seg_start))::bigint AS work_sec,
            p.service_code ~ 'キャンセル'::text AS is_cancel
           FROM per_day p
        ), tsuin_month AS (
         SELECT s.target_month,
            s."従業員番号",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.is_cancel THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.work_sec <= 0 THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.kaipoke_cs_id = '9999999980'::text THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN COALESCE(s.ssc_summary_flg, ''::text) ~~* '%通院等介助%'::text AND COALESCE(s.ssc_summary_flg, ''::text) ~~* '%身体なし%'::text THEN s.work_sec
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END)::bigint AS tsuin_sec
           FROM segmented s
          GROUP BY s.target_month, s."従業員番号"
        )
 SELECT m."Version",
    m."従業員識別子",
    m."従業員番号",
    m."姓",
    m."名",
    m."事業所名",
    m."部門名",
    m."職種名",
    m."契約種別",
    m."出勤日数（平日）",
    m."所定時間（平日）",
    m."深夜所定時間（平日）",
    m."有休取得日数",
    m."処遇改善加算",
    m."特定処遇改善加算",
    m."身体・同行・行動時間",
    m."重訪移動時間",
    m."移動回数",
    m."独自回数",
    m."食事回数",
    m."キャンセル回数",
    m."年末年始出勤時間",
    m."サービス回数",
    m.target_month,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(t.tsuin_sec, 0::bigint) <= 0 THEN '0'::text
            ELSE ceil(COALESCE(t.tsuin_sec, 0::bigint)::numeric / 3600.0)::text
        END AS "通院等介助（身体なし）時間"
   FROM shift_mfcloud_payroll_monthly m
     LEFT JOIN tsuin_month t ON t.target_month = m.target_month AND t."従業員番号" = m."従業員番号";

views.name: shift_mfcloud_payroll_monthly_plus_yearend
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp without time zone)::date AS target_month,
            s.shift_id,
            s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            s.service_code,
            make_timestamp(EXTRACT(year FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(month FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_start_date)::integer, EXTRACT(hour FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer, EXTRACT(minute FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer, EXTRACT(second FROM s.shift_start_time)::integer::double precision) AS start_ts,
            make_timestamp(EXTRACT(year FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(month FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(day FROM s.shift_end_date)::integer, EXTRACT(hour FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer, EXTRACT(minute FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer, EXTRACT(second FROM s.shift_end_time)::integer::double precision) AS end_ts,
            u.user_id AS "従業員番号"
           FROM shift_add_status_view s
             JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (s.staff_01_user_id), (s.staff_02_user_id), (s.staff_03_user_id)) u(user_id) ON u.user_id IS NOT NULL
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_end_date IS NOT NULL
        ), per_day AS (
         SELECT b.target_month,
            b."従業員番号",
            b.shift_id,
            b.kaipoke_cs_id,
            b.service_code,
            d.d::date AS work_date,
            GREATEST(b.start_ts, d.d) AS seg_start,
            LEAST(b.end_ts, d.d + '1 day'::interval) AS seg_end
           FROM base b
             JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('day'::text, b.start_ts), date_trunc('day'::text, b.end_ts - '00:00:01'::interval), '1 day'::interval) d(d) ON b.end_ts > b.start_ts
        ), segmented AS (
         SELECT p.target_month,
            p."従業員番号",
            p.work_date,
            p.kaipoke_cs_id,
            p.service_code,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM p.seg_end - p.seg_start))::bigint AS work_sec,
            p.service_code ~ 'キャンセル'::text AS is_cancel
           FROM per_day p
        ), yearend_month AS (
         SELECT s.target_month,
            s."従業員番号",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.is_cancel THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.work_sec <= 0 THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.kaipoke_cs_id = '9999999980'::text THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM s.work_date) = 12::numeric AND EXTRACT(day FROM s.work_date) >= 30::numeric OR EXTRACT(month FROM s.work_date) = 1::numeric AND EXTRACT(day FROM s.work_date) <= 3::numeric THEN s.work_sec
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END)::bigint AS yearend_sec
           FROM segmented s
          GROUP BY s.target_month, s."従業員番号"
        ), tsuin_month AS (
         SELECT s.target_month,
            s."従業員番号",
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.is_cancel THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.work_sec <= 0 THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.kaipoke_cs_id = '9999999980'::text THEN 0::bigint
                    WHEN s.service_code = '通院(伴ず)'::text THEN s.work_sec
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END)::bigint AS tsuin_sec
           FROM segmented s
          GROUP BY s.target_month, s."従業員番号"
        )
 SELECT m."Version",
    m."従業員識別子",
    m."従業員番号",
    m."姓",
    m."名",

        END AS "年末年始出勤時間",

        END AS "通院等介助（身体なし）時間"

     LEFT JOIN tsuin_month t ON t.target_month = m.target_month AND t."従業員番号" = m."従業員番号";

views.name: shift_rpa_status_view

SELECT s.shift_id,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM rpa_command_requests r
          WHERE ((r.request_details ->> 'shift_id'::text)::bigint) = s.shift_id AND r.template_id = 'caf1a290-b9ac-4eeb-84eb-eb7fd9936c2f'::uuid AND (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'processing'::text, 'running'::text, 'completed'::text])))) AS has_rpa_request
   FROM shift_shift_record_view s;

views.name: shift_self_coordinate_card_view
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT v.shift_id,
            v.shift_start_date,
            v.shift_start_time,
            v.shift_end_time,
            v.service_code,
            v.kaipoke_cs_id,
            v.staff_01_user_id,
            v.level_sort_order,
            v.staff_01_kaipoke_user_id,
            v.staff_02_user_id,
            v.staff_02_kaipoke_user_id,
            v.staff_03_kaipoke_user_id,
            v.staff_03_user_id,
            v.tokutei_comment,
            v.postal_code,
            v.name,
            v.gender_request_name,
            v.male_flg,
            v.female_flg,
            v.postal_code_3,
            v.district,
            v.require_doc_group,
            v.kaipoke_servicek,
            v.kaipoke_servicecode,
            v.roster_sort,
            v.staff_01_role_code,
            v.staff_02_role_code,
            v.staff_03_role_code,
            v.required_staff_count,
            v.two_person_work_flg,
            v.judo_ido,
            v.staff_02_attend_flg,
            v.staff_03_attend_flg,
            v.staff_01_level_sort,
            v.staff_02_level_sort,
            v.staff_03_level_sort,
            v.dsp_short,
            k.address,
                CASE
                    WHEN ev.value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'::text THEN ev.value::numeric
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS base_hourly_wage,
            COALESCE(sc.additional_hourly_wage, 0)::numeric AS additional_hourly_wage,
            COALESCE(sc.per_service_amount, 0)::numeric AS per_service_amount,
            COALESCE(pd.transport_fee_per_service, 0)::numeric AS transport_fee_per_service,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.shift_start_date IS NULL OR v.shift_start_time IS NULL OR v.shift_end_time IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    WHEN v.shift_end_time >= v.shift_start_time THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM v.shift_start_date + v.shift_end_time - (v.shift_start_date + v.shift_start_time)) / 3600.0
                    ELSE EXTRACT(epoch FROM v.shift_start_date + v.shift_end_time + '1 day'::interval - (v.shift_start_date + v.shift_start_time)) / 3600.0
                END AS service_hours,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(v.shift_start_date + v.shift_end_time, v.shift_start_date + '19:00:00'::time without time zone) - GREATEST(v.shift_start_date + v.shift_start_time, v.shift_start_date + '08:00:00'::time without time zone)) / 3600.0) AS normal_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN v.shift_start_date IS NULL OR v.shift_start_time IS NULL OR v.shift_end_time IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    WHEN v.shift_end_time >= v.shift_start_time THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM v.shift_start_date + v.shift_end_time - (v.shift_start_date + v.shift_start_time)) / 3600.0
                    ELSE EXTRACT(epoch FROM v.shift_start_date + v.shift_end_time + '1 day'::interval - (v.shift_start_date + v.shift_start_time)) / 3600.0
                END - GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(v.shift_start_date + v.shift_end_time, v.shift_start_date + '19:00:00'::time without time zone) - GREATEST(v.shift_start_date + v.shift_start_time, v.shift_start_date + '08:00:00'::time without time zone)) / 3600.0) AS premium_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(v.judo_ido, '0000'::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'::text AND COALESCE(v.judo_ido, '0000'::text) <> '0000'::text THEN SUBSTRING(v.judo_ido FROM 1 FOR 2)::numeric + SUBSTRING(v.judo_ido FROM 3 FOR 2)::numeric / 60.0
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS judo_ido_hours
           FROM shift_csinfo_postalname_view v
             LEFT JOIN cs_kaipoke_info k ON v.kaipoke_cs_id = k.kaipoke_cs_id
             LEFT JOIN shift_service_code sc ON v.service_code = sc.service_code
             LEFT JOIN postal_district pd ON v.postal_code_3 = pd.postal_code_3
             LEFT JOIN env_variables ev ON ev.group_key = 'shift_self_coordinate'::text AND ev.key_name = 'base_hourly_wage'::text
        )
 SELECT base.shift_id,
    base.shift_start_date,
    base.shift_start_time,
    base.shift_end_time,
    base.service_code,
    base.kaipoke_cs_id,
    base.staff_01_user_id,
    base.level_sort_order,
    base.staff_01_kaipoke_user_id,
    base.staff_02_user_id,
    base.staff_02_kaipoke_user_id,
    base.staff_03_kaipoke_user_id,
    base.staff_03_user_id,
    base.tokutei_comment,
    base.postal_code,
    base.name,
    base.gender_request_name,
    base.male_flg,
    base.female_flg,
    base.postal_code_3,
    base.district,
    base.require_doc_group,
    base.kaipoke_servicek,
    base.kaipoke_servicecode,
    base.roster_sort,
    base.staff_01_role_code,
    base.staff_02_role_code,
    base.staff_03_role_code,
    base.required_staff_count,
    base.two_person_work_flg,
    base.judo_ido,
    base.staff_02_attend_flg,

views.name: shift_summary_monthly_cs_view
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month_start,
            to_char(date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone), 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS year_month,
            s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM upper(s.shift_timerange) - lower(s.shift_timerange)) / 3600.0 AS shift_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(s.staff_01_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(s.staff_02_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false) = false THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(s.staff_03_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false) = false THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS participant_cnt
           FROM shift s
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_start_time IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.kaipoke_cs_id !~~ '999999999%'::text AND (s.service_code IS NULL OR s.service_code !~~* '%キャンセル%'::text)
        ), monthly AS (
         SELECT base.kaipoke_cs_id,
            base.month_start,
            base.year_month,
            round(sum(base.shift_hours * base.participant_cnt::numeric), 2) AS total_hours
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.kaipoke_cs_id, base.month_start, base.year_month
        ), active_cs AS (
         SELECT i.kaipoke_cs_id,
            i.name AS cs_name
           FROM cs_kaipoke_info i
          WHERE i.is_active = true
        ), months AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT monthly.month_start,
            monthly.year_month
           FROM monthly
        ), grid AS (
         SELECT ac.kaipoke_cs_id,
            ac.cs_name,
            m.month_start,
            m.year_month
           FROM active_cs ac
             CROSS JOIN months m
        ), grid_with_hours AS (
         SELECT g.kaipoke_cs_id,
            g.cs_name,
            g.month_start,
            g.year_month,
            COALESCE(mm.total_hours, 0::numeric) AS this_month_hours
           FROM grid g
             LEFT JOIN monthly mm ON mm.kaipoke_cs_id = g.kaipoke_cs_id AND mm.month_start = g.month_start
        ), with_prev AS (
         SELECT gwh.kaipoke_cs_id,
            gwh.cs_name,
            gwh.month_start,
            gwh.year_month,
            gwh.this_month_hours,
            lag(gwh.this_month_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY gwh.kaipoke_cs_id ORDER BY gwh.month_start) AS prev_month_hours_raw
           FROM grid_with_hours gwh
        )
 SELECT with_prev.kaipoke_cs_id,
    with_prev.cs_name,
    with_prev.month_start,
    with_prev.year_month,
    with_prev.this_month_hours,
    COALESCE(with_prev.prev_month_hours_raw, 0::numeric) AS prev_month_hours,
    with_prev.this_month_hours - COALESCE(with_prev.prev_month_hours_raw, 0::numeric) AS diff_hours
   FROM with_prev
  ORDER BY with_prev.kaipoke_cs_id, with_prev.month_start;

views.name: shift_summary_monthly_team_view
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month_start,
            to_char(date_trunc('month'::text, s.shift_start_date::timestamp with time zone), 'YYYYMM'::text) AS year_month,
            o.orgunitid,
            o.orgunitname,
            EXTRACT(epoch FROM upper(s.shift_timerange) - lower(s.shift_timerange)) / 3600.0 AS shift_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(s.staff_01_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(s.staff_02_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.staff_02_attend_flg, false) = false THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(s.staff_03_user_id, ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.staff_03_attend_flg, false) = false THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS participant_cnt
           FROM shift s
             JOIN cs_kaipoke_info c ON c.kaipoke_cs_id = s.kaipoke_cs_id
             LEFT JOIN orgs o ON o.orgunitid = c.asigned_org::text
          WHERE s.shift_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_start_time IS NOT NULL AND s.shift_end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.kaipoke_cs_id !~~ '99999999%'::text AND (s.service_code IS NULL OR s.service_code !~~* '%キャンセル%'::text)
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT base.month_start,
            base.year_month,
            COALESCE(base.orgunitid, 'UNASSIGNED'::text) AS orgunitid,
            COALESCE(base.orgunitname, '未割当'::text) AS orgunitname,
            round(sum(base.shift_hours * base.participant_cnt::numeric), 2) AS total_hours
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.month_start, base.year_month, (COALESCE(base.orgunitid, 'UNASSIGNED'::text)), (COALESCE(base.orgunitname, '未割当'::text))
        ), total AS (
         SELECT agg.month_start,
            agg.year_month,
            'TOTAL'::text AS orgunitid,
            'total'::text AS orgunitname,
            round(sum(agg.total_hours), 2) AS total_hours
           FROM agg
          GROUP BY agg.month_start, agg.year_month
        ), unioned AS (
         SELECT agg.month_start,
            agg.year_month,
            agg.orgunitid,
            agg.orgunitname,
            agg.total_hours
           FROM agg
        UNION ALL
         SELECT total.month_start,
            total.year_month,
            total.orgunitid,
            total.orgunitname,
            total.total_hours
           FROM total
        )
 SELECT u.month_start,
    u.year_month,
    u.orgunitid,
    u.orgunitname,
    u.total_hours,
    round(avg(u.total_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY u.orgunitid ORDER BY u.month_start ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS avg_3m_hours
   FROM unioned u
  ORDER BY u.month_start, u.orgunitname;

views.name: shift_wish_portal_view
views.definition:
WITH areas AS (
         SELECT sw_1.id,
            COALESCE(string_agg(elem.value ->> 'district'::text, '、'::text ORDER BY (elem.value ->> 'district'::text)), ''::text) AS area_text
           FROM shift_wishes sw_1
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(sw_1.postal_area_json, '[]'::jsonb)) elem(value) ON true
          GROUP BY sw_1.id
        ), wday AS (
         SELECT sw_1.id,
            COALESCE(string_agg(substr('日月火水木金土'::text, elem.value::integer + 1, 1), '・'::text ORDER BY (elem.value::integer)), ''::text) AS weekday_text
           FROM shift_wishes sw_1
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(sw_1.preferred_weekday, '[]'::jsonb)) elem(value) ON true
          GROUP BY sw_1.id
        ), pdate AS (
         SELECT sw_1.id,
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(sw_1.preferred_date, '[]'::jsonb)) = 0 THEN ''::text
                    WHEN jsonb_array_length(sw_1.preferred_date) = 1 THEN sw_1.preferred_date ->> 0
                    ELSE (sw_1.preferred_date ->> 0) || ' 他'::text
                END AS date_text
           FROM shift_wishes sw_1
        ), q_qual AS (
         SELECT u_1.auth_user_id,
            COALESCE(string_agg(COALESCE(elem.value ->> 'label'::text, elem.value ->> 'name'::text, elem.value ->> 'type'::text), '・'::text), ''::text) AS qual_text
           FROM users u_1
             LEFT JOIN form_entries fe_1 ON fe_1.id = u_1.entry_id
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(fe_1.license_files, COALESCE(fe_1.certifications, '[]'::jsonb))) elem(value) ON true
          GROUP BY u_1.auth_user_id
        )
 SELECT sw.id,
    sw.user_id,
    sw.request_type,
    sw.preferred_date,
    sw.preferred_weekday,
    sw.time_start_hour,
    sw.time_end_hour,
    sw.postal_area_json,
    a.area_text,
    (COALESCE(fe.last_name_kanji, ''::text) || ' '::text) || COALESCE(fe.first_name_kanji, ''::text) AS full_name,
    COALESCE(fe.gender, ''::text) AS gender,
    qq.qual_text,
    sw.created_at,
    sw.updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN w.weekday_text <> ''::text THEN ((((('毎週'::text || w.weekday_text) || ' '::text) || lpad(COALESCE(sw.time_start_hour, 0)::text, 2, '0'::text)) || ':00〜'::text) || lpad(COALESCE(sw.time_end_hour, 0)::text, 2, '0'::text)) || ':00'::text
            WHEN p.date_text <> ''::text THEN ((((p.date_text || ' '::text) || lpad(COALESCE(sw.time_start_hour, 0)::text, 2, '0'::text)) || ':00〜'::text) || lpad(COALESCE(sw.time_end_hour, 0)::text, 2, '0'::text)) || ':00'::text
            ELSE ((lpad(COALESCE(sw.time_start_hour, 0)::text, 2, '0'::text) || ':00〜'::text) || lpad(COALESCE(sw.time_end_hour, 0)::text, 2, '0'::text)) || ':00'::text
        END AS schedule_text,
    '氏名非公開'::text || COALESCE(('（'::text || COALESCE(fe.gender, ''::text)) || '）'::text, ''::text) AS fax_name_masked
   FROM shift_wishes sw
     LEFT JOIN users u ON sw.user_id = u.auth_user_id
     LEFT JOIN form_entries fe ON fe.id = u.entry_id
     LEFT JOIN areas a ON a.id = sw.id
     LEFT JOIN wday w ON w.id = sw.id
     LEFT JOIN pdate p ON p.id = sw.id
     LEFT JOIN q_qual qq ON qq.auth_user_id = sw.user_id;

views.definition:
SELECT a.id AS applicant_id,
    a.taimee_user_id,
    a.last_name AS "姓",
    a.first_name AS "名",
    a.last_name_kana AS "姓カナ",
    a.first_name_kana AS "名カナ",
    a.phone AS "電話番号",
    a.normalized_phone,
    a.gender AS "性別",
    a.address AS "住所",
    a.entry_id,
    a.link_status,
        CASE
            WHEN a.link_status = 'linked'::text AND a.entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS in_entry,
    a.black_list,
    a.send_disabled,
    a.memo,
    a.last_sent_at,
    a.last_fetched_at,
    a.fetch_status,
    a.fetch_error,
    latest_job.id AS latest_applicant_job_id,
    latest_job.taimee_job_id AS latest_job_id,
    latest_job.shift_id AS latest_shift_id,
    latest_job.job_name AS latest_job_name,
    latest_job.work_date AS latest_work_date,
    latest_job.start_time AS latest_start_time,
    latest_job.end_time AS latest_end_time,
    latest_job.period_month,
    latest_job.application_status,
    latest_job.applicant_control_url AS latest_job_control_url,
    COALESCE(a.applicant_control_url, latest_job.applicant_control_url) AS applicant_control_url,
    COALESCE(document_counts.employment_contract_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS employment_contract_count,
    COALESCE(document_counts.qualification_certificate_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS qualification_certificate_count,
    COALESCE(document_counts.identity_document_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS identity_document_count,
    COALESCE(document_counts.other_document_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS other_document_count,
    COALESCE(document_counts.total_document_count, 0::bigint)::integer AS total_document_count,
    a.created_at,
    a.updated_at
   FROM taimee_applicants a
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT j.id,
            j.taimee_job_id,
            j.shift_id,
            j.job_name,
            j.work_date,
            j.start_time,
            j.end_time,
            j.period_month,
            j.application_status,
            j.applicant_control_url,
            j.first_detected_at,
            j.last_detected_at
           FROM taimee_applicant_jobs j
          WHERE j.applicant_id = a.id
          ORDER BY j.work_date DESC NULLS LAST, j.last_detected_at DESC NULLS LAST, j.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) latest_job ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.document_type = 'employment_contract'::text) AS employment_contract_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.document_type = 'qualification_certificate'::text) AS qualification_certificate_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.document_type = 'identity_document'::text) AS identity_document_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.document_type = 'other'::text) AS other_document_count,
            count(*) AS total_document_count
           FROM taimee_applicant_documents d
          WHERE d.applicant_id = a.id) document_counts ON true;

views.name: tokutei_clone_targets_view
views.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT s.shift_id,
            s.kaipoke_cs_id,
            s.shift_start_date,
            s.shift_start_time,
            s.shift_end_date,
            s.shift_end_time,
            s.tokutei_comment
           FROM shift s
          WHERE s.tokutei_comment IS NULL AND s.shift_start_date >= '2025-10-01'::date AND s.shift_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND s.kaipoke_cs_id IS NOT NULL AND s.kaipoke_cs_id !~~ '99999999%'::text
        ), middle_excluded AS (
         SELECT b.shift_id,
            b.kaipoke_cs_id,
            b.shift_start_date,
            b.shift_start_time,
            b.shift_end_date,
            b.shift_end_time,
            b.tokutei_comment
           FROM base b
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM shift s1
                  WHERE s1.kaipoke_cs_id = b.kaipoke_cs_id AND s1.shift_end_time IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s1.shift_end_date, s1.shift_start_date) = b.shift_start_date AND s1.shift_end_time = b.shift_start_time))
        ), with_prev AS (
         SELECT b.shift_id,
            b.kaipoke_cs_id,
            b.shift_start_date,
            b.shift_start_time,
            b.shift_end_date,
            b.shift_end_time,
            b.tokutei_comment,
            p.prev_shift_id
           FROM middle_excluded b
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s2.shift_id AS prev_shift_id
                   FROM shift s2
                  WHERE s2.kaipoke_cs_id = b.kaipoke_cs_id AND ((ROW(s2.shift_start_date, s2.shift_start_time) < ROW(b.shift_start_date, b.shift_start_time)))
                  ORDER BY s2.shift_start_date DESC, s2.shift_start_time DESC
                 LIMIT 1) p ON true
        )
 SELECT w.shift_id AS target_shift_id,
    w.kaipoke_cs_id,
    w.shift_start_date,
    w.shift_start_time,
    w.prev_shift_id,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM shift_records r
          WHERE r.shift_id = w.prev_shift_id AND (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'approved'::text, 'archived'::text])))) AS has_executed_record
   FROM with_prev w
  WHERE w.prev_shift_id IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM shift_records r
          WHERE r.shift_id = w.prev_shift_id AND (r.status = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'approved'::text, 'archived'::text]))));
